diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/app/http/routes/head_markup_injection_test.go b/apps/gooseforum/app/http/routes/head_markup_injection_test.go
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..79fded33b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/app/http/routes/head_markup_injection_test.go
@@ -0,0 +1,114 @@
+package routes
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"net/http"
+	"regexp"
+	"strings"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/pageConfig"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/hotdataserve"
+)
+
+// issueHeadMarkup 是 issue #1244 中站点设置里实际生效的那段整段 <head> payload。
+const issueHeadMarkup = "<head>\n" +
+	"    <meta charset=\"UTF-8\">\n" +
+	"    <meta name=\"viewport\" content=\"width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0\">\n" +
+	"    <title>YourTJ社区</title>\n" +
+	"    <meta name=\"description\" content=\"同济大学学生社区\">\n" +
+	"    <meta name=\"keywords\" content=\"forum,discussion,community,YourTJ,同济大学,YourTJ社区\">\n" +
+	"    <meta name=\"robots\" content=\"index, follow\">\n" +
+	"    <meta name=\"author\" content=\"YourTJ Community\">\n" +
+	"</head>\n"
+
+// issueHeadMarkupSanitized 是 issueHeadMarkup 净化后的期望值：只保留自定义 meta。
+const issueHeadMarkupSanitized = "<meta name=\"keywords\" content=\"forum,discussion,community,YourTJ,同济大学,YourTJ社区\"/>\n" +
+	"<meta name=\"author\" content=\"YourTJ Community\"/>"
+
+// TestSiteSettingsHeadMarkupStaysInsideHead 断言站点设置注入的 head 片段不会造出
+// 嵌套 <head> 或重复的 viewport/title/description/robots（issue #1244），
+// 同时自定义 meta 仍然进 head —— 证明净化是结构化剥离，不是整段丢弃。
+func TestSiteSettingsHeadMarkupStaysInsideHead(t *testing.T) {
+	router := securityHeadersTestRouter(t, "production")
+	conn := dbconnect.Connect()
+	persistContractPageConfig(t, conn, pageConfig.SiteSettings, pageConfig.SiteSettingsConfig{
+		SiteName:      "契约站点",
+		ExternalLinks: issueHeadMarkup,
+	})
+	hotdataserve.ClearSiteSettingsConfigCache()
+	t.Cleanup(hotdataserve.ClearSiteSettingsConfigCache)
+
+	for _, page := range []struct {
+		path string
+		// robots 是页面外壳自己的取值（搜索页 noindex）；为空表示该页不输出 robots。
+		robots string
+	}{
+		{path: "/"},
+		{path: "/login"},
+		{path: "/search?q=test", robots: "noindex,follow"},
+	} {
+		body := fetchSSRHTML(t, router, page.path)
+		assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<head[ >]`, 1)
+		assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<title[ >]`, 1)
+		assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<meta[^>]+name="viewport"`, 1)
+		// 外壳的 description 按页条件输出，注入的那条（连同取值）必须整体消失。
+		if strings.Contains(body, "同济大学学生社区") {
+			t.Errorf("GET %s: injected description meta survived", page.path)
+		}
+		if page.robots == "" {
+			assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<meta[^>]+name="robots"`, 0)
+		} else {
+			assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<meta[^>]+name="robots"`, 1)
+			if want := `content="` + page.robots + `"`; !strings.Contains(body, want) {
+				t.Errorf("GET %s: robots meta missing %s", page.path, want)
+			}
+		}
+		// 自定义内容保留：净化只剥结构标签和外壳自有标签。
+		assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<meta[^>]+name="keywords"`, 1)
+		assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<meta[^>]+name="author"`, 1)
+		assertTagCount(t, page.path, body, `(?i)<meta[^>]+charset`, 1)
+	}
+}
+
+// TestSaveSiteSettingsSanitizesHeadMarkup 断言写入路径也净化（issue #1244）：整段
+// <head> 在落库前就被剥离，存量脏配置在管理员下次保存站点设置时被清理。
+func TestSaveSiteSettingsSanitizesHeadMarkup(t *testing.T) {
+	conn, router := setupAdminSiteContractTest(t)
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		conn.Where("page_type = ?", pageConfig.SiteSettings).Delete(&pageConfig.Entity{})
+	})
+	body, err := json.Marshal(map[string]any{"settings": map[string]any{
+		"siteName":               "契约站点",
+		"externalLinks":          issueHeadMarkup,
+		"trustedExternalDomains": []string{"github.com"},
+	}})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatalf("encode save-site-settings body: %v", err)
+	}
+	serveAdminSiteRaw(t, conn, router, http.MethodPost, "/api/admin/save-site-settings", string(body))
+
+	stored := pageConfig.GetConfigByPageType(pageConfig.SiteSettings, pageConfig.SiteSettingsConfig{})
+	if stored.ExternalLinks != issueHeadMarkupSanitized {
+		t.Fatalf("stored externalLinks = %q, want %q", stored.ExternalLinks, issueHeadMarkupSanitized)
+	}
+}
+
+func fetchSSRHTML(t *testing.T, router http.Handler, path string) string {
+	t.Helper()
+	response := performSecurityHeadersRequest(router, http.MethodGet, path, "text/html")
+	if response.Code != http.StatusOK {
+		t.Fatalf("GET %s status=%d, want 200 (body=%s)", path, response.Code, response.Body.String())
+	}
+	return response.Body.String()
+}
+
+// assertTagCount 统计响应 HTML 中真实标记的出现次数。payload JSON 里的同名片段
+// 由 encoding/json 转义（形如 \u003cmeta），不会计入。
+func assertTagCount(t *testing.T, path, body, pattern string, want int) {
+	t.Helper()
+	if got := len(regexp.MustCompile(pattern).FindAllStringIndex(body, -1)); got != want {
+		t.Errorf("GET %s: %d matches of %s, want %d", path, got, pattern, want)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,57 @@
+package routes
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"fmt"
+	"sync/atomic"
+	"testing"
+
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/defaultconfig"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/pageConfig"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/hotdataserve"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+func TestNewTopicMentionRenderingDoesNotReenterSingleConnectionPool(t *testing.T) {
+	conn, router := setupHTTPContractTest(t)
+	author := createHTTPContractUser(t, conn, contractTestID())
+	mentioned := createHTTPContractUser(t, conn, contractTestID())
+	config := defaultconfig.GetDefaultPostingSettingsConfig()
+	config.TextControl.NewUserPostCooldownMinutes = 0
+	persistHTTPContractConfig(t, conn, pageConfig.PostingSettings, config)
+	hotdataserve.ClearPostingSettingsConfigCache()
+	token := contractSessionToken(t, author)
+	pool, err := conn.DB()
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	original := pool.Stats().MaxOpenConnections
+	pool.SetMaxOpenConns(1)
+	defer pool.SetMaxOpenConns(original)
+	body := fmt.Sprintf(`{"title":"Single connection mention publication","content":"Please read this complete post @%s","categoryId":[1],"topicStatus":1,"contentType":3}`, mentioned.Username)
+	var reentered atomic.Bool
+	const hook = "test:single-connection-render"
+	if err := conn.Callback().Query().Before("gorm:query").Register(hook, func(tx *gorm.DB) {
+		// Fail the would-be reentrant query before it blocks forever. Ordinary reads
+		// have no checked-out connection; transaction reads use *sql.Tx instead.
+		if tx.Statement.ConnPool == pool && pool.Stats().InUse == 1 {
+			reentered.Store(true)
+			_ = tx.AddError(errors.New("reentrant query during publication transaction"))
+		}
+	}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	defer func() {
+		if err := conn.Callback().Query().Remove(hook); err != nil {
+			t.Errorf("remove query callback: %v", err)
+		}
+	}()
+	response := serveJSON(router, "/api/forum/topics/write", body, token)
+	if reentered.Load() {
+		t.Fatal("new-topic rendering requested a second connection inside its write transaction")
+	}
+	envelope := decodeContractEnvelope(t, response)
+	if response.Code != 200 || envelope.Code != 0 {
+		t.Fatalf("write failed: %d %#v", response.Code, envelope)
+	}
+}

@@ -84,5 +84,13 @@ App 在前台浏览公开页面时向 YourTJ 自托管的 Umami 服务（umi.you
 
 App 进入后台时停止发送并丢弃待发送项，退出后不保留内存中的统计缓存标记；
 App 不在磁盘上保存访问队列或访客标识，不重试失败的统计请求。调试版本、其他站点、
 Web 和桌面端构建不会通过此原生统计通道发送数据。已送达服务的数据按该统计服务的保留
 设置管理，不会随 App 退出而撤回。状态页只公开粗粒度设备、系统、客户端类别和汇总数量。
+
+## 信息流推荐与质量评估
+
+启用推荐统计时，平台会把已登录账号与列表展示的话题、可视曝光、详情打开、前台停留（每条最多记录600秒）、点赞/收藏状态、首次公开发帖/回复及实验分组关联，用于排序质量评估和故障排查。推荐统计由论坛自身处理，与 Umami 匿名访问统计分别管理；不采集正文、搜索词、私信、定位或设备标识。
+
+启用为你推荐时，首页公开卡片在前台至少50%进入视野并连续保持1秒，会按账号与话题保存一条已见状态，用于在推荐的新批次中排除已经看过且没有有效新回复的帖子，不要求点击详情。此状态最多保留30天；它记录卡片取数时的内容截点，不表示已读完整帖子。其他账号的新公开回复可以让话题再次进入推荐候选。已见确认不依赖质量统计开关，不为全站排名或积分提供信用，其他栏目和未读圆点的规则保持原有含义。
+
+可识别的行为原始记录、候选样本和实验分组最多保留30天，24小时排名事实按24小时窗口清理。到期记录立即停止参与读取，由后台限量物理清理；账号注销后停止接收该账号的事件，并清理其原始记录与内存推荐快照。客户端只在内存暂存上报项，不把追踪标记、已见凭证或浏览会话写入离线页面缓存。浏览器最多在内存保存两个推荐浏览会话，30分钟未活动失效，注销或换账号即清除。长期质量汇总不包含账号标识，管理界面仅提供汇总数据。常规数据库备份排除这些原始记录；恢复后推荐追踪和实验周期失效，不复活历史分组。

- **会话回放**：启用记录的会话可能包含鼠标移动、点击、滚动、页面导航和表单交互；采样比例、输入/文本遮罩级别、最长记录时长与排除区域由 Umami 站点配置控制。请勿在公开 URL、帖子或其他非敏感输入区域提交密码、Token、证件号等敏感信息。
- **保存与用途**：上述数据仅用于站点运行分析、体验改进与故障排查，由自建 Umami 服务处理；具体保存期限以服务端配置为准。

## 信息流推荐与质量评估

启用推荐统计时，平台会把已登录账号与列表展示的话题、可视曝光、详情打开、前台停留（每条最多记录600秒）、点赞/收藏状态、首次公开发帖/回复及实验分组关联，用于排序质量评估和故障排查。推荐统计由论坛自身处理，与 Umami 匿名访问统计分别管理；不采集正文、搜索词、私信、定位或设备标识。

可识别的行为原始记录、候选样本和实验分组最多保留30天，24小时排名事实按24小时窗口清理。到期记录立即停止参与读取，由后台限量物理清理；账号注销后停止接收该账号的事件，并清理其原始记录与内存推荐快照。客户端只在内存暂存上报项，不把追踪标记写入离线页面缓存。长期质量汇总不包含账号标识，管理界面仅提供汇总数据。常规数据库备份排除这些原始记录；恢复后推荐追踪和实验周期失效，不复活历史分组。

## 联系

如对隐私处理有疑问，请通过站点公开联系方式与我们沟通。

+// Package anonymousIdentity owns persistent public personas and their private bindings.
+package anonymousIdentity
+
+import (
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+	"time"
+)
+
+type Persona struct {
+	UID                   string    `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(32)" json:"publicUid"`
+	Name                  string    `gorm:"type:text;not null" json:"name"`
+	AvatarSeed            string    `gorm:"type:varchar(32);not null" json:"-"`
+	NameSelectedAt        time.Time `json:"-"`
+	NameChangeAvailableAt time.Time `json:"-"`
+	Disabled              bool      `gorm:"not null;default:false" json:"-"`
+	GovernanceDisabled    bool      `gorm:"not null;default:false" json:"-"`
+	ShowContent           bool      `gorm:"not null;default:true" json:"-"`
+}
+
+func (Persona) TableName() string { return "anonymous_personas" }
+
+// Bindings and reveal audits survive account closure, per the approved retention policy.
+// Never serialize them into ordinary admin, moderation or public responses.
+type Binding struct {
+	OwnerID        uint64 `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false" json:"-"`
+	PersonaUID     string `gorm:"type:varchar(32);not null;uniqueIndex" json:"-"`
+	SelectionBatch string `gorm:"type:varchar(32);not null" json:"-"`
+	SelectionIndex int    `gorm:"not null" json:"-"`
+}
+
+func (Binding) TableName() string { return "anonymous_bindings" }
+
+type Quota struct {
+	OwnerID uint64 `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false" json:"-"`
+	Day     string `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(10)" json:"-"`
+	Used    int    `gorm:"not null;default:0" json:"-"`
+}
+
+func (Quota) TableName() string { return "anonymous_name_quotas" }
+
+type Batch struct {
+	ID         string    `gorm:"primaryKey;type:varchar(32)" json:"id"`
+	OwnerID    uint64    `gorm:"not null;uniqueIndex:uniq_anonymous_request,priority:1" json:"-"`
+	Day        string    `gorm:"type:varchar(10);not null;uniqueIndex:uniq_anonymous_request,priority:2;index" json:"day"`
+	RequestKey string    `gorm:"type:varchar(128);not null;uniqueIndex:uniq_anonymous_request,priority:3" json:"-"`
+	Words      []string  `gorm:"type:text;serializer:json;not null" json:"words"`
+	ExpiresAt  time.Time `gorm:"index" json:"expiresAt"`
+	CreatedAt  time.Time `json:"createdAt"`
+}
+
+func (Batch) TableName() string { return "anonymous_name_batches" }
+
+type RevealAudit struct {
+	Action     string    `gorm:"type:varchar(32);not null;default:reveal" json:"-"`
+	ID         uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey" json:"-"`
+	ActorID    uint64    `gorm:"not null" json:"-"`
+	PersonaUID string    `gorm:"type:varchar(32);not null;index" json:"-"`
+	OwnerID    uint64    `gorm:"not null" json:"-"`
+	Reason     string    `gorm:"type:text;not null" json:"-"`
+	TraceID    string    `gorm:"type:varchar(128);not null" json:"-"`
+	CreatedAt  time.Time `json:"-"`
+}
+
+func (RevealAudit) TableName() string { return "anonymous_reveal_audits" }
+
+func GetMap(conn *gorm.DB, uids []string) (map[string]Persona, error) {
+	result := make(map[string]Persona)
+	if len(uids) == 0 {
+		return result, nil
+	}
+	var rows []Persona
+	if err := conn.Where("uid IN ?", uids).Find(&rows).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	for _, row := range rows {
+		result[row.UID] = row
+	}
+	return result, nil
+}

+// Package contributionstats 提供管理后台「内容贡献统计」的只读数据访问。
+//
+// 统计对象是论坛内容表本身（topics / posts / topic_category_index /
+// post_user_action），不是推荐系统的遥测事件：不读推荐原始事件，也不改变任何保留期限。
+// 目录内的查询全部是只读聚合，写入路径不经过本包。
+package contributionstats
+
+import "time"
+
+// ContentKind 区分统计的内容类型：主题与回复（回复 = post_no > 1，首楼属于主题）。
+type ContentKind int
+
+const (
+	KindTopic ContentKind = iota
+	KindReply
+)
+
+// SortKey 是用户排行支持的排序指标（白名单，其余取值在执行前被拒绝）。
+type SortKey string
+
+const (
+	SortByTopics  SortKey = "topics"
+	SortByReplies SortKey = "replies"
+	SortByLikes   SortKey = "likes"
+)
+
+// Scope 是一次统计的只读口径范围。时间区间为左闭右开 [Start, End)，
+// 调用方按服务器本地日换算成边界时刻（Start = 起始日 00:00，End = 结束日次日 00:00）。
+type Scope struct {
+	Start      time.Time
+	End        time.Time
+	CategoryID uint64 // 0 = 全站（不按板块过滤）
+	UserID     uint64 // 0 = 不限作者
+}
+
+// CategoryCount 是某个板块下的一项计数（内容量或去重贡献人数）。
+type CategoryCount struct {
+	CategoryId uint64 `gorm:"column:category_id"`
+	Count      int64  `gorm:"column:count"`
+}
+
+// ContentTotal 是内容维度的一行汇总：计数 + 该范围是否含估算时间归属。
+type ContentTotal struct {
+	Count     int64 `gorm:"column:count"`
+	Estimated bool  `gorm:"column:estimated"`
+}
+
+// DailyCount 是单日的内容计数；Day 为服务器本地日 "YYYY-MM-DD"。
+// Estimated 表示该日计入的内容里是否存在估算时间归属（首次公开时间缺失或为回填估算）。
+type DailyCount struct {
+	Day       string `gorm:"column:day"`
+	Count     int64  `gorm:"column:count"`
+	Estimated bool   `gorm:"column:estimated"`
+}
+
+// RankingRow 是用户排行中的一行：该账号在范围内贡献的主题、回复与当前有效获赞。
+type RankingRow struct {
+	UserId     uint64 `gorm:"column:user_id"`
+	TopicCount int64  `gorm:"column:topic_count"`
+	ReplyCount int64  `gorm:"column:reply_count"`
+	LikeCount  int64  `gorm:"column:like_count"`
+}
+
+// RankingTotal 是用户排行的去重账号总数（分页依据）与该范围内是否有估算时间归属：
+// total 与 estimated 由同一条 UNION 扫描产出，两者永远描述同一批计入的行（口径 R4/R8）。
+type RankingTotal struct {
+	Total     int64 `gorm:"column:total"`
+	Estimated bool  `gorm:"column:estimated"`
+}
+
+// UserContentTotal 是单个账号的内容汇总。
+type UserContentTotal struct {
+	TopicCount int64 `gorm:"column:topic_count"`
+	ReplyCount int64 `gorm:"column:reply_count"`
+	LikeCount  int64 `gorm:"column:like_count"`
+}

new file mode 100644
index 000000000..93f20d78f
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/contributionstats/contributionstats_rep.go
@@ -0,0 +1,354 @@
+package contributionstats
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"fmt"
+	"time"
+
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/topics"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/users"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+const (
+	topicsTable = "topics"
+	postsTable  = "posts"
+	indexTable  = "topic_category_index"
+	actionTable = "post_user_action"
+)
+
+// topicScopePredicate 复用 topics 归属方的规范公开谓词 + 首楼可见性半连接：
+// 主题必须「当前公开」（已发布、已过审、未删除、非 wiki）且首楼仍可见（issue #492），
+// 与公开列表/排行榜同一口径，不在本包复制等值条件。status + process_status 等值也让
+// first_public_at 缺失时的 created_at 支路能走
+// idx_topics_list_new(status, process_status, created_at DESC, id DESC)。
+var topicScopePredicate = topics.PublicScopePredicate("t") + " AND " + topics.FirstPostVisiblePredicate("t")
+
+// 内容范围谓词（口径 R1）。写成固定 SQL 字面量以保持聚合语句可读；
+// 修改内容可见性口径时必须同步本组谓词与 topics 的规范谓词。
+const (
+	// replyScopePredicate：楼层自身公开未删除且不是首楼（回复 = post_no > 1）。
+	replyScopePredicate = "p.deleted_at IS NULL AND p.visibility_status = 'ACTIVE' AND p.process_status = 0 AND p.post_no > 1"
+
+	// 时间归属谓词（口径 R2）：有效时间 = 首次公开时间优先、缺失回退创建时间。
+	// 拆成两个可索引分支（等价于 COALESCE 落在区间内），参数顺序均为 [start,end,start,end)。
+	topicRangePredicate = "((t.first_public_at IS NOT NULL AND t.first_public_at >= ? AND t.first_public_at < ?) OR (t.first_public_at IS NULL AND t.created_at >= ? AND t.created_at < ?))"
+	replyRangePredicate = "((p.first_public_at IS NOT NULL AND p.first_public_at >= ? AND p.first_public_at < ?) OR (p.first_public_at IS NULL AND p.created_at >= ? AND p.created_at < ?))"
+
+	// 按用户归因时必须排除匿名行（口径 R4）：匿名只掩码展示，user_id 仍是真实作者。
+	topicAuthorPredicate = "t.persona_uid = ''"
+	replyAuthorPredicate = "p.persona_uid = '' AND p.is_anonymous = false"
+
+	topicEffectiveExpr  = "COALESCE(t.first_public_at, t.created_at)"
+	replyEffectiveExpr  = "COALESCE(p.first_public_at, p.created_at)"
+	topicEstimatedExpr  = "(t.first_public_at IS NULL OR t.first_public_estimated)"
+	replyEstimatedExpr  = "(p.first_public_at IS NULL OR p.first_public_estimated)"
+	rankingOuterSelect  = "SELECT author_totals.user_id AS user_id, SUM(author_totals.topic_count) AS topic_count, SUM(author_totals.reply_count) AS reply_count, SUM(author_totals.like_count) AS like_count FROM (? UNION ALL ?) AS author_totals GROUP BY author_totals.user_id"
+	rankingTotalSelect  = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT authors.user_id) AS total, COALESCE(MAX(authors.estimated), 0) AS estimated FROM (? UNION ALL ?) AS authors"
+	userTotalSelect     = "SELECT COALESCE(SUM(author_totals.topic_count), 0) AS topic_count, COALESCE(SUM(author_totals.reply_count), 0) AS reply_count, COALESCE(SUM(author_totals.like_count), 0) AS like_count FROM (? UNION ALL ?) AS author_totals"
+	contributorCountSQL = "SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT authors.user_id) AS total FROM (? UNION ALL ?) AS authors"
+	contributorGroupSQL = "SELECT authors.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT authors.user_id) AS count FROM (? UNION ALL ?) AS authors GROUP BY authors.category_id ORDER BY authors.category_id ASC"
+	categoryColumns     = "tci.category_id AS category_id, "
+	categoryIndexJoin   = "JOIN topic_category_index AS tci ON tci.topic_id = t.id AND tci.effective = 1"
+	replyLikeJoin       = "LEFT JOIN post_user_action AS pua ON pua.post_id = p.id AND pua.liked_at IS NOT NULL"
+	topicRankingSelect  = "t.user_id AS user_id, COUNT(*) AS topic_count, 0 AS reply_count, COALESCE(SUM(t.like_count), 0) AS like_count"
+	replyRankingSelect  = "p.user_id AS user_id, 0 AS topic_count, COUNT(DISTINCT p.id) AS reply_count, COUNT(pua.id) AS like_count"
+	topicRankingGroupBy = "t.user_id"
+	replyRankingGroupBy = "p.user_id"
+	rankingOrderTopics  = "topic_count DESC, author_totals.user_id ASC"
+	rankingOrderReplies = "reply_count DESC, author_totals.user_id ASC"
+	rankingOrderLikes   = "like_count DESC, author_totals.user_id ASC"
+)
+
+// CategoryCounts 返回区间内每个板块的内容量（口径 R3）：多板块主题在每个所属板块各计一次。
+func CategoryCounts(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) ([]CategoryCount, error) {
+	return categoryCounts(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, kind)
+}
+
+// SiteContentTotal 返回全站内容量：不 JOIN 板块索引，因此多板块主题只计一次。
+// 同时返回区间内是否存在估算时间归属的行，供 coverage 使用（口径 R8）。
+func SiteContentTotal(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) (ContentTotal, error) {
+	return siteContentTotal(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, kind)
+}
+
+// CategoryDailyCounts 返回每个板块逐日的内容量（升序），供板块趋势使用。
+// 内容口径含匿名内容；只返回有内容的日期，缺失日由调用方补 0。
+func CategoryDailyCounts(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) ([]DailyCount, error) {
+	return categoryDailyCounts(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, kind)
+}
+
+// UserDailyCounts 返回某账号逐日的内容量（升序），按用户归因（排除该账号的匿名内容）。
+func UserDailyCounts(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, userID uint64, kind ContentKind) ([]DailyCount, error) {
+	return userDailyCounts(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, userID, kind)
+}
+
+// CategoryContributorCounts 返回区间内每个板块的去重贡献人数（口径 R4）：
+// 主题作者与回复作者取并集后按账号去重，排除匿名行与已注销账号；只统计指定主体类型。
+func CategoryContributorCounts(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, actorType int8) ([]CategoryCount, error) {
+	return categoryContributorCounts(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, actorType)
+}
+
+// SiteContributorCount 返回全站去重贡献人数（口径 R4）：主题作者与回复作者并集去重，
+// 排除匿名行与已注销账号；只统计指定主体类型。
+func SiteContributorCount(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, actorType int8) (int64, error) {
+	return siteContributorCount(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, actorType)
+}
+
+// UserRanking 返回区间内的用户贡献排行（只含指定主体类型；匿名与已注销账号不出现）。
+// 排序稳定：同值按 user_id 升序。
+func UserRanking(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, actorType int8, sort SortKey, offset, limit int) ([]RankingRow, error) {
+	return userRanking(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, actorType, sort, offset, limit)
+}
+
+// UserRankingTotal 返回同一筛选下的账号总数（分页依据）与该范围内是否有估算时间归属。
+// 两者在同一条 UNION 扫描里产出，因此 estimated 与 total 描述的是同一批计入的行。
+func UserRankingTotal(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, actorType int8) (RankingTotal, error) {
+	return userRankingTotal(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, actorType)
+}
+
+// UserContentTotals 返回单个账号在区间内贡献的内容量与当前有效获赞（口径 R5）。
+func UserContentTotals(ctx context.Context, scope Scope, userID uint64) (UserContentTotal, error) {
+	return userContentTotals(db.ConnectContext(ctx), scope, userID)
+}
+
+// 以下查询实现都接受显式连接：默认路径由上面的导出函数注入全局连接，
+// PostgreSQL 方言测试可直接传入真实 PG 连接复用同一份 SQL。
+
+func categoryCounts(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) ([]CategoryCount, error) {
+	query := contentQuery(conn, scope, kind).Joins(categoryIndexJoin)
+	if scope.CategoryID > 0 {
+		query = query.Where("tci.category_id = ?", scope.CategoryID)
+	}
+	var rows []CategoryCount
+	err := query.
+		Select("tci.category_id AS category_id, COUNT(*) AS count").
+		Group("tci.category_id").
+		Order("tci.category_id ASC").
+		Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+func siteContentTotal(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) (ContentTotal, error) {
+	var row ContentTotal
+	err := contentQuery(conn, scope, kind).
+		Select("COUNT(*) AS count, " + estimatedFlagSelect(estimatedExpr(kind))).
+		Scan(&row).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+func categoryDailyCounts(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) ([]DailyCount, error) {
+	// 板块筛选走 contentQuery 的 IN 子查询，不再 JOIN 索引表：
+	// 逐日分组时 JOIN 会让跨板块主题在未给板块筛选时重复计数。
+	return scanDailyCounts(contentQuery(conn, scope, kind), kind)
+}
+
+func userDailyCounts(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, userID uint64, kind ContentKind) ([]DailyCount, error) {
+	scope.UserID = userID
+	return scanDailyCounts(authorQuery(conn, scope, nil, kind), kind)
+}
+
+func categoryContributorCounts(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType int8) ([]CategoryCount, error) {
+	// 指定板块时两条作者子查询都必须按该板块收窄，否则会带出其他板块的分组行。
+	// 收窄只走索引表 JOIN 的 tci.category_id 等值：这里清掉 scope 的板块谓词，
+	// 免得再叠一层等价的 `t.id IN (子查询)`（评审 nit：双重过滤冗余）。
+	joinedScope := scope
+	joinedScope.CategoryID = 0
+	topicAuthors := authorQuery(conn, joinedScope, &actorType, KindTopic).
+		Joins(categoryIndexJoin).
+		Select(categoryColumns + "t.user_id AS user_id")
+	replyAuthors := authorQuery(conn, joinedScope, &actorType, KindReply).
+		Joins(categoryIndexJoin).
+		Select(categoryColumns + "p.user_id AS user_id")
+	if scope.CategoryID > 0 {
+		topicAuthors = topicAuthors.Where("tci.category_id = ?", scope.CategoryID)
+		replyAuthors = replyAuthors.Where("tci.category_id = ?", scope.CategoryID)
+	}
+	var rows []CategoryCount
+	err := conn.Raw(contributorGroupSQL, topicAuthors, replyAuthors).Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+func siteContributorCount(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType int8) (int64, error) {
+	topicAuthors := authorQuery(conn, scope, &actorType, KindTopic).Select("t.user_id AS user_id")
+	replyAuthors := authorQuery(conn, scope, &actorType, KindReply).Select("p.user_id AS user_id")
+	var row struct {
+		Total int64 `gorm:"column:total"`
+	}
+	err := conn.Raw(contributorCountSQL, topicAuthors, replyAuthors).Scan(&row).Error
+	return row.Total, err
+}
+
+func userRanking(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType int8, sort SortKey, offset, limit int) ([]RankingRow, error) {
+	var rows []RankingRow
+	err := conn.
+		Raw(rankingOuterSelect+" ORDER BY "+rankingOrder(sort)+" LIMIT ? OFFSET ?",
+			topicRankingQuery(conn, scope, &actorType),
+			replyRankingQuery(conn, scope, &actorType),
+			limit, offset).
+		Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+func userRankingTotal(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType int8) (RankingTotal, error) {
+	var row RankingTotal
+	err := conn.
+		Raw(rankingTotalSelect,
+			topicRankingQuery(conn, scope, &actorType),
+			replyRankingQuery(conn, scope, &actorType)).
+		Scan(&row).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+func userContentTotals(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, userID uint64) (UserContentTotal, error) {
+	scope.UserID = userID
+	var row UserContentTotal
+	err := conn.
+		Raw(userTotalSelect,
+			topicRankingQuery(conn, scope, nil),
+			replyRankingQuery(conn, scope, nil)).
+		Scan(&row).Error
+	return row, err
+}
+
+// contentQuery 组装内容范围查询：主题或回复，别名固定（t / p）。
+func contentQuery(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, kind ContentKind) *gorm.DB {
+	switch kind {
+	case KindReply:
+		query := conn.
+			Table(postsTable+" AS p").
+			Joins("JOIN "+topicsTable+" AS t ON t.id = p.topic_id").
+			Where(topicScopePredicate).
+			Where(replyScopePredicate).
+			Where(replyRangePredicate, rangeArgs(scope)...)
+		if scope.UserID > 0 {
+			query = query.Where("p.user_id = ?", scope.UserID)
+		}
+		return applyCategoryScope(conn, query, scope)
+	default:
+		query := conn.
+			Table(topicsTable+" AS t").
+			Where(topicScopePredicate).
+			Where(topicRangePredicate, rangeArgs(scope)...)
+		if scope.UserID > 0 {
+			query = query.Where("t.user_id = ?", scope.UserID)
+		}
+		return applyCategoryScope(conn, query, scope)
+	}
+}
+
+// authorQuery 在内容范围之上叠加按用户归因的谓词（口径 R4）：匿名行排除，
+// actorType 非 nil 时只保留该主体类型且未注销的账号。
+func authorQuery(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType *int8, kind ContentKind) *gorm.DB {
+	query := contentQuery(conn, scope, kind)
+	switch kind {
+	case KindReply:
+		query = query.Where(replyAuthorPredicate)
+		if actorType != nil {
+			query = query.Where("p.user_id IN (?)", users.ActorAuthorIDsQueryTx(conn, *actorType))
+		}
+	default:
+		query = query.Where(topicAuthorPredicate)
+		if actorType != nil {
+			query = query.Where("t.user_id IN (?)", users.ActorAuthorIDsQueryTx(conn, *actorType))
+		}
+	}
+	return query
+}
+
+// topicRankingQuery 按作者聚合主题数与主题获赞（R5：获赞取 topics.like_count 之和）。
+// 每个作者顺带产出估算标记，供总数扫描在同一个 UNION 里取 MAX（口径 R8）。
+func topicRankingQuery(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType *int8) *gorm.DB {
+	return authorQuery(conn, scope, actorType, KindTopic).
+		Select(topicRankingSelect + ", " + estimatedFlagSelect(topicEstimatedExpr)).
+		Group(topicRankingGroupBy)
+}
+
+// replyRankingQuery 按作者聚合回复数与回复获赞（R5：只统计 liked_at 非空的当前有效点赞，
+// 取消点赞只置空该列不删行）。
+func replyRankingQuery(conn *gorm.DB, scope Scope, actorType *int8) *gorm.DB {
+	return authorQuery(conn, scope, actorType, KindReply).
+		Joins(replyLikeJoin).
+		Select(replyRankingSelect + ", " + estimatedFlagSelect(replyEstimatedExpr)).
+		Group(replyRankingGroupBy)
+}
+
+func applyCategoryScope(conn *gorm.DB, query *gorm.DB, scope Scope) *gorm.DB {
+	if scope.CategoryID == 0 {
+		return query
+	}
+	return query.Where("t.id IN (?)", categoryTopicIDsQuery(conn, scope.CategoryID))
+}
+
+func categoryTopicIDsQuery(conn *gorm.DB, categoryID uint64) *gorm.DB {
+	return conn.
+		Table(indexTable).
+		Select("topic_id").
+		Where("effective = 1").
+		Where("category_id = ?", categoryID)
+}
+
+func scanDailyCounts(query *gorm.DB, kind ContentKind) ([]DailyCount, error) {
+	dayExpr := localDayExpr(query, effectiveExpr(kind))
+	var rows []DailyCount
+	err := query.
+		Select(dayExpr + " AS day, COUNT(*) AS count, " + estimatedFlagSelect(estimatedExpr(kind))).
+		Group(dayExpr).
+		Order("day ASC").
+		Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+// localDayExpr 把时间表达式截断为「服务器本地日」字符串（'YYYY-MM-DD'），
+// 与 dailyStats 写入侧（time.Now().Format("2006-01-02")）同口径。
+//
+// 两种方言都按「绝对时刻 + 本地时区偏移后取 UTC 日历日」换算，语义与
+// time.Time.In(time.Local) 一致；偏移量取查询时刻的 time.Local 偏移，
+// 只在无夏令时的服务器时区（部署约束，见 docs/operations/deployment.md 的
+// 「服务器时区：必须无夏令时」）与逐日换算完全一致，测试兜底见
+// TestDeploymentTimezoneHasNoDST。SQLite 用 strftime 的秒偏移修饰符、
+// PostgreSQL 用 make_interval，避免依赖数据库会话时区，也避免 BOOL_OR 这类方言专有聚合。
+func localDayExpr(conn *gorm.DB, effective string) string {
+	_, offset := time.Now().In(time.Local).Zone()
+	// gorm 内嵌 Dialector 接口，conn.Name() 即方言名（postgres / sqlite）。
+	if conn.Name() == "postgres" {
+		return fmt.Sprintf("to_char((%s + make_interval(secs => %d)) AT TIME ZONE 'UTC', 'YYYY-MM-DD')", effective, offset)
+	}
+	return fmt.Sprintf("strftime('%%Y-%%m-%%d', %s, '%+d seconds')", effective, offset)
+}
+
+// estimatedFlagSelect 返回「该范围是否含估算时间归属」的聚合片段（口径 R8）。
+// 站点汇总、逐日分桶与排行子查询共用同一段 SQL 文本，避免同一标记出现多种写法。
+func estimatedFlagSelect(estimatedExpr string) string {
+	return "MAX(CASE WHEN " + estimatedExpr + " THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS estimated"
+}
+
+func estimatedExpr(kind ContentKind) string {
+	if kind == KindReply {
+		return replyEstimatedExpr
+	}
+	return topicEstimatedExpr
+}
+
+func effectiveExpr(kind ContentKind) string {
+	if kind == KindReply {
+		return replyEffectiveExpr
+	}
+	return topicEffectiveExpr
+}
+
+func rangeArgs(scope Scope) []any {
+	return []any{scope.Start, scope.End, scope.Start, scope.End}
+}
+
+// rankingOrder 返回白名单内的排序片段；未知取值回退主题数（服务层已拒绝非法值）。
+func rankingOrder(sort SortKey) string {
+	switch sort {
+	case SortByReplies:
+		return rankingOrderReplies
+	case SortByLikes:
+		return rankingOrderLikes
+	default:
+		return rankingOrderTopics
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,54 @@
+package decoration
+
+import "time"
+
+// Definition stores administrator-managed styles; colors and asset paths are
+// validated by decorationservice before they can reach a renderer.
+type Definition struct {
+	AssetScale  float64  `gorm:"not null;default:1.25" json:"assetScale"`
+	AssetURL    string   `gorm:"size:160;not null;default:''" json:"assetUrl,omitempty"`
+	Code        string   `gorm:"primaryKey;size:64" json:"code"`
+	Name        string   `gorm:"size:80;not null" json:"name"`
+	Kind        string   `gorm:"size:24;not null" json:"kind"`
+	LightColors []string `gorm:"type:json;serializer:json" json:"lightColors"`
+	DarkColors  []string `gorm:"type:json;serializer:json" json:"darkColors"`
+	IsEnabled   bool     `gorm:"not null" json:"isEnabled"`
+	SortOrder   int      `gorm:"not null;default:0" json:"sortOrder"`

+package feed
+
+import (
+	"encoding/json"
+	"os"
+	"reflect"
+	"slices"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestDeploymentRawTableListMatchesOwner(t *testing.T) {
+	data, err := os.ReadFile("../../../../../../deploy/scripts/feed-raw-tables.json")
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var tables []string
+	if err = json.Unmarshal(data, &tables); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	want := append([]string{}, RawTables...)
+	slices.Sort(want)
+	slices.Sort(tables)
+	if !reflect.DeepEqual(want, tables) {
+		t.Fatalf("backup raw-table list differs: %v != %v", tables, want)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,23 @@
+package posts
+
+import "gorm.io/gorm"
+
+type PersonaParticipant struct {
+	TopicID    uint64
+	PersonaUID string
+}
+
+// PersonaParticipants bounds each visible topic's public participant projection.
+// Neither the selected columns nor the result contains the private owner.
+func PersonaParticipants(conn *gorm.DB, topicIDs []uint64) ([]PersonaParticipant, error) {
+	if len(topicIDs) == 0 {
+		return []PersonaParticipant{}, nil
+	}
+	var rows []PersonaParticipant
+	err := conn.Raw(`SELECT topic_id, persona_uid FROM (
+ SELECT topic_id, persona_uid, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY topic_id ORDER BY MIN(id)) AS position
+ FROM posts WHERE topic_id IN ? AND persona_uid <> '' AND deleted_at IS NULL
+ AND retention_status <> 'PURGED' AND visibility_status = ? AND process_status = ? GROUP BY topic_id, persona_uid
+ ) participants WHERE position <= 12 ORDER BY topic_id, position`, topicIDs, VisibilityActive, ProcessStatusNormal).Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,22 @@
+package posts
+
+import (
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+// PublicPersonaPosts excludes hidden parents, deleted first posts and retained evidence.
+func PublicPersonaPosts(conn *gorm.DB, uid string, page int) ([]Entity, int64, int64, error) {
+	base := func() *gorm.DB {
+		return conn.Model(&Entity{}).Where("posts.persona_uid = ? AND posts.process_status = 0 AND posts.visibility_status = 'ACTIVE' AND posts.retention_status <> 'PURGED'", uid).Where("EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM topics t JOIN posts f ON f.id=t.first_post_id AND f.topic_id=t.id WHERE t.id=posts.topic_id AND t.status=1 AND t.process_status=0 AND t.visibility_status='ACTIVE' AND t.retention_status<>'PURGED' AND t.topic_type=0 AND t.deleted_at IS NULL AND f.process_status=0 AND f.visibility_status='ACTIVE' AND f.retention_status<>'PURGED' AND f.deleted_at IS NULL)")
+	}
+	var topics, replies int64
+	if err := base().Where("posts.post_no = 1").Count(&topics).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, 0, 0, err
+	}
+	if err := base().Where("posts.post_no > 1").Count(&replies).Error; err != nil {
+		return nil, 0, 0, err
+	}
+	var rows []Entity
+	err := base().Where("posts.post_no > 1").Order("posts.id DESC").Offset((max(page, 1) - 1) * 20).Limit(20).Find(&rows).Error
+	return rows, topics, replies, err
+}

+package topicUserAction
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/preferences"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/feed"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestNativeActionCommitsOwnerCreditAndEventToTheirOwnTables(t *testing.T) {
+	conn := db.Connect()
+	models := append(feed.Models(), &Entity{})
+	if err := conn.AutoMigrate(models...); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	preferences.Set("ranking.enabled", true)
+	preferences.Set("feed.metrics.enabled", true)
+	const uid, topic uint64 = 976812, 976813
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		preferences.Set("ranking.enabled", false)
+		preferences.Set("feed.metrics.enabled", false)
+		conn.Where("user_id = ?", uid).Delete(&Entity{})
+		conn.Where("topic_id = ?", topic).Delete(&feed.ActionCredit{})
+		conn.Where("user_id = ?", uid).Delete(&feed.Event{})
+		conn.Where("user_id = ?", uid).Delete(&feed.Owner{})
+		conn.Where("topic_id = ?", topic).Delete(&feed.Schedule{})
+	})
+	changed, err := SetState(context.Background(), uid, topic, "liked_at", true)
+	if err != nil || !changed {
+		t.Fatalf("native action failed changed=%v: %v", changed, err)
+	}
+	changed, err = SetState(context.Background(), uid, topic, "liked_at", true)
+	if err != nil || changed {
+		t.Fatalf("duplicate state emitted: %v %v", changed, err)
+	}
+	var events int64
+	if err = conn.Model(&feed.Event{}).Where("user_id = ?", uid).Count(&events).Error; err != nil || events != 1 {
+		t.Fatalf("events=%d %v", events, err)
+	}
+	if err = conn.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error { return feed.CloseTx(tx, uid) }); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if _, err = SetState(context.Background(), uid, topic, "liked_at", false); err == nil {
+		t.Fatal("closed owner wrote event")
+	}
+	var native Entity
+	if err = conn.First(&native, "user_id = ? AND topic_id = ?", uid, topic).Error; err != nil || native.LikedAt == nil {
+		t.Fatal("event failure did not roll back native state")
+	}
+}

+package topicUserAction
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/users"
+	"time"
+)
+
+func RankLikers(ctx context.Context, topicID uint64) ([]uint64, error) {
+	var ids []uint64
+	err := builder().WithContext(ctx).Select("user_id").Where("topic_id = ? AND liked_at IS NOT NULL", topicID).Where("user_id IN (?)", users.EligibleIDsQuery(ctx)).Limit(50001).Find(&ids).Error
+	return ids, err
+}
+
+type ProfileAction struct {
+	TopicID uint64
+	At      time.Time
+}
+
+func ProfileActions(ctx context.Context, uid uint64, kind string, after time.Time) ([]ProfileAction, error) {
+	field := "liked_at"
+	if kind == "bookmark" {
+		field = "bookmarked_at"
+	}
+	var rows []ProfileAction
+	err := builder().WithContext(ctx).Select("topic_id,"+field+" AS at").Where("user_id = ? AND "+field+" >= ?", uid, after).Order(field + " DESC").Limit(50).Scan(&rows).Error
+	return rows, err
+}
+
+// ActorTopicIDs returns a bounded batch for identity-driven rank invalidation.
+func ActorTopicIDs(ctx context.Context, uid, after uint64) ([]uint64, error) {
+	var ids []uint64
+	err := builder().WithContext(ctx).Select("topic_id").Where("user_id = ? AND topic_id > ?", uid, after).Order("topic_id").Limit(200).Find(&ids).Error
+	return ids, err
+}

+package topics
+
+import (
+	"fmt"
+	"reflect"
+	"testing"
+)
+
+func TestPublicGallery(t *testing.T) {
+	long := make([]string, 0, 11)
+	for i := 0; i < 11; i++ {
+		long = append(long, fmt.Sprintf("/file/img/%d.webp", i))
+	}
+	for _, tc := range []struct {
+		name string
+		in   Entity
+		want []string
+	}{
+		{"gallery wins", Entity{ImageUrls: []string{"/a", "/b"}, FirstImageURL: "/c"}, []string{"/a", "/b"}},
+		{"fallback", Entity{FirstImageURL: "/c"}, []string{"/c"}},
+		{"empty", Entity{}, []string{}},
+		{"capped", Entity{ImageUrls: long}, long[:MaxPublicGalleryImages]},
+		{"duplicates and order kept", Entity{ImageUrls: []string{"/b", "/a", "/b"}}, []string{"/b", "/a", "/b"}},
+		{"blank entries dropped", Entity{ImageUrls: []string{"", "/a", "  ", "\t", "/b"}}, []string{"/a", "/b"}},
+		{"blank gallery falls back", Entity{ImageUrls: []string{" "}, FirstImageURL: "/c"}, []string{"/c"}},
+		{"blank fallback", Entity{FirstImageURL: "   "}, []string{}},
+		{"cap after dropping blanks", Entity{ImageUrls: append([]string{"", " "}, long...)}, long[:MaxPublicGalleryImages]},
+	} {
+		got := tc.in.PublicGallery()
+		if !reflect.DeepEqual(got, tc.want) {
+			t.Errorf("%s: PublicGallery() = %#v, want %#v", tc.name, got, tc.want)

@@ -0,0 +1,42 @@
+package topics
+
+import "fmt"
+
+// PublicScopePredicate 返回「当前公开论坛主题」的规范谓词（带表别名）：
+// 已发布（status=1）、已过审、未进入删除生命周期、且不是 wiki 页面。
+//
+// 新增公开列表/统计入口一律以它为准，避免各自复制谓词导致口径漂移
+// （历史问题：各入口手写等值条件，出现「列表可见但统计可见」之类的偏差）。
+// 只有单篇 Markdown 导出用 ExportScopePredicate（issue #1166 含 wiki）。
+func PublicScopePredicate(alias string) string {
+	return publishedBasePredicate(alias) + fmt.Sprintf(" AND %s.topic_type = %d", alias, TopicTypeForum)
+}
+
+// ExportScopePredicate 返回「可导出的单篇主题」谓词（带表别名）：与 PublicScopePredicate
+// 相同的发布/审核/可见/未删除条件，主题类型按白名单放行（论坛话题 + wiki 页面），
+// 新增的第三种类型默认不导出。
+//
+// issue #1166 决定恢复 wiki 页面的单篇 Markdown 导出（#1160 让单篇导出复用公开谓词后
+// 误把 wiki 页面变成 404）；列表、索引/全文导出与内容统计口径仍以 PublicScopePredicate
+// 为准，继续排除 wiki。
+func ExportScopePredicate(alias string) string {
+	return publishedBasePredicate(alias) + fmt.Sprintf(" AND %s.topic_type IN (%d, %d)", alias, TopicTypeForum, TopicTypeWiki)
+}
+
+// publishedBasePredicate 是两条公开谓词共用的发布/审核/可见/删除生命周期条件（带表别名）。
+func publishedBasePredicate(alias string) string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf(
+		"%[1]s.status = 1 AND %[1]s.process_status = %[2]d AND %[1]s.visibility_status = '%[3]s' AND %[1]s.deleted_at IS NULL",
+		alias, ProcessStatusNormal, VisibilityActive,
+	)
+}
+
+// FirstPostVisiblePredicate 返回首楼可见性半连接条件（带表别名）：首楼已过审、
+// 未软删、未进入删除生命周期。首楼被删除/擦除后主题无正文，继续公开展示会产生
+// 「有标题无正文」的孤儿条目（issue #492），因此所有公开列表/导出入口都应附加本条件。
+func FirstPostVisiblePredicate(alias string) string {
+	return fmt.Sprintf(
+		"(SELECT posts.process_status FROM posts WHERE posts.id = %[1]s.first_post_id AND posts.topic_id = %[1]s.id AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL AND posts.visibility_status = '%[2]s') = %[3]d",
+		alias, VisibilityActive, ProcessStatusNormal,
+	)
+}

+package topics
+
+import "testing"
+
+// TestPublicScopePredicatesAreCanonical 固定规范谓词的逐字文本：公开列表、关注流、
+// 排行榜与内容贡献统计共用它，文档与 API 契约也按此原文描述口径；
+// 任何改动都必须同步 docs/ 与 packages/api-contract。
+func TestPublicScopePredicatesAreCanonical(t *testing.T) {
+	if got, want := PublicScopePredicate("topics"),
+		"topics.status = 1 AND topics.process_status = 0 AND topics.visibility_status = 'ACTIVE' AND topics.deleted_at IS NULL AND topics.topic_type = 0"; got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("PublicScopePredicate = %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+	if got, want := ExportScopePredicate("topics"),
+		"topics.status = 1 AND topics.process_status = 0 AND topics.visibility_status = 'ACTIVE' AND topics.deleted_at IS NULL AND topics.topic_type IN (0, 1)"; got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("ExportScopePredicate = %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+	if got, want := FirstPostVisiblePredicate("topics"),
+		"(SELECT posts.process_status FROM posts WHERE posts.id = topics.first_post_id AND posts.topic_id = topics.id AND posts.deleted_at IS NULL AND posts.visibility_status = 'ACTIVE') = 0"; got != want {
+		t.Fatalf("FirstPostVisiblePredicate = %q, want %q", got, want)
+	}
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,51 @@
+package users
+
+import (
+	"strconv"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/localcache"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/cacheconfig"
+)
+
+// blockedPeersCacheTTL bounds how long a cached reader-level answer may
+// outlive an out-of-band relation change. It matches the shared public list
+// cache window (hotdataserve topicListCacheTTL), so a relation change that
+// never reaches the write path lags a list refresh by at most one list-cache
+// window. Relations changed through SetBlockedUser are invalidated instead of
+// waiting out this TTL.
+const blockedPeersCacheTTL = 5 * time.Second
+
+var blockedPeersCache = localcache.Cache[bool]{MaxEntries: cacheconfig.Current().BlockedPeers}
+
+// HasBlockedPeersCached is the public-list variant of HasBlockedPeers: it
+// answers from a short-lived per-user cache so the shared list cache-hit path
+// performs no per-request existence query (issue #1129). Block writes
+// invalidate the entry, so new or removed relations are visible immediately;
+// the TTL only bounds changes that bypass SetBlockedUser. Loader errors are
+// not cached and reach the caller, which fails open.
+func HasBlockedPeersCached(userID uint64) (bool, error) {
+	if userID == 0 {
+		return false, nil
+	}
+	return blockedPeersCache.GetOrLoadE(blockedPeersCacheKey(userID), func() (bool, error) {
+		return HasBlockedPeers(userID)
+	}, blockedPeersCacheTTL)
+}
+
+// InvalidateBlockedPeersCache drops the cached answers for the given users.
+// Callers pass both sides of a relation change: a block in either direction
+// flips the public-list decision of both users. localcache also rejects a load
+// that raced the invalidation, so a stale answer can never be written back.
+func InvalidateBlockedPeersCache(userIDs ...uint64) {
+	for _, userID := range userIDs {
+		if userID == 0 {
+			continue
+		}
+		blockedPeersCache.Delete(blockedPeersCacheKey(userID))
+	}
+}
+
+func blockedPeersCacheKey(userID uint64) string {
+	return "user:blocked-peers:" + strconv.FormatUint(userID, 10)
+}

index 000000000..43be5755e
--- /dev/null

@@ -0,0 +1,127 @@
+package users
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"slices"
+	"time"
+
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+	"gorm.io/gorm/clause"
+)
+
+// Profile audiences, ordered from the widest to the narrowest.
+const (
+	AudienceEveryone  = "everyone"
+	AudienceMembers   = "members"
+	AudienceFollowers = "followers"
+	AudienceMutual    = "mutual"
+	AudienceSelf      = "self"
+)
+
+var ErrPrivacyAudience = errors.New("invalid privacy audience")
+
+// PrivacySettingsEntity stores which profile aggregates other people may see.
+// A missing row means the public defaults that predate the setting, so
+// existing accounts need no backfill. It never controls access to the
+// underlying topics, replies or relationships.
+type PrivacySettingsEntity struct {
+	UserID          uint64    `gorm:"primaryKey;autoIncrement:false;not null" json:"-"`
+	ProfileTopics   string    `gorm:"type:varchar(16);not null;default:'everyone'" json:"profileTopics"`
+	ProfileActivity string    `gorm:"type:varchar(16);not null;default:'everyone'" json:"profileActivity"`
+	ProfileLikes    string    `gorm:"type:varchar(16);not null;default:'everyone'" json:"profileLikes"`
+	FollowingList   string    `gorm:"type:varchar(16);not null;default:'everyone'" json:"followingList"`
+	FollowersList   string    `gorm:"type:varchar(16);not null;default:'everyone'" json:"followersList"`
+	UpdatedAt       time.Time `json:"-"`
+}
+
+func (PrivacySettingsEntity) TableName() string { return "user_privacy_settings" }
+
+// PrivacySettingsUpdate carries a partial owner update; nil fields keep their value.
+type PrivacySettingsUpdate struct {
+	ProfileTopics   *string
+	ProfileActivity *string
+	ProfileLikes    *string
+	FollowingList   *string
+	FollowersList   *string
+}
+
+var allProfileAudiences = []string{AudienceEveryone, AudienceMembers, AudienceFollowers, AudienceMutual, AudienceSelf}
+
+// PrivacyAudiences lists the audiences each setting accepts. Likes and
+// relationship lists omit combinations the issue contract does not offer.
+var PrivacyAudiences = map[string][]string{
+	"profileTopics":   allProfileAudiences,
+	"profileActivity": allProfileAudiences,
+	"profileLikes":    {AudienceEveryone, AudienceFollowers, AudienceSelf},
+	"followingList":   {AudienceEveryone, AudienceFollowers, AudienceMutual, AudienceSelf},
+	"followersList":   {AudienceEveryone, AudienceFollowers, AudienceMutual, AudienceSelf},
+}
+
+func DefaultPrivacySettings(userID uint64) PrivacySettingsEntity {
+	return PrivacySettingsEntity{UserID: userID, ProfileTopics: AudienceEveryone, ProfileActivity: AudienceEveryone, ProfileLikes: AudienceEveryone, FollowingList: AudienceEveryone, FollowersList: AudienceEveryone}
+}
+
+// GetPrivacySettings returns stored settings or the public defaults. Storage
+// errors are returned so callers can fail closed.
+func GetPrivacySettings(userID uint64) (PrivacySettingsEntity, error) {
+	settings := DefaultPrivacySettings(userID)
+	err := db.Connect().Where("user_id = ?", userID).Take(&settings).Error
+	if errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
+		return DefaultPrivacySettings(userID), nil
+	}
+	return settings, err
+}
+
+// UpdatePrivacySettings validates every supplied audience before writing, then
+// applies the partial update atomically on top of the current row.
+func UpdatePrivacySettings(userID uint64, update PrivacySettingsUpdate) (PrivacySettingsEntity, error) {
+	return updatePrivacySettings(db.Connect(), userID, update)
+}
+
+func updatePrivacySettings(conn *gorm.DB, userID uint64, update PrivacySettingsUpdate) (PrivacySettingsEntity, error) {
+	fields := []struct {
+		key    string
+		column string
+		value  *string
+		apply  func(*PrivacySettingsEntity, string)
+	}{
+		{"profileTopics", "profile_topics", update.ProfileTopics, func(s *PrivacySettingsEntity, v string) { s.ProfileTopics = v }},
+		{"profileActivity", "profile_activity", update.ProfileActivity, func(s *PrivacySettingsEntity, v string) { s.ProfileActivity = v }},
+		{"profileLikes", "profile_likes", update.ProfileLikes, func(s *PrivacySettingsEntity, v string) { s.ProfileLikes = v }},
+		{"followingList", "following_list", update.FollowingList, func(s *PrivacySettingsEntity, v string) { s.FollowingList = v }},
+		{"followersList", "followers_list", update.FollowersList, func(s *PrivacySettingsEntity, v string) { s.FollowersList = v }},
+	}
+	for _, field := range fields {
+		if field.value != nil && !validPrivacyAudience(field.key, *field.value) {
+			return PrivacySettingsEntity{}, ErrPrivacyAudience
+		}
+	}
+	var settings PrivacySettingsEntity
+	err := conn.Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
+		settings = DefaultPrivacySettings(userID)
+		if err := tx.Clauses(clause.Locking{Strength: "UPDATE"}).Where("user_id = ?", userID).Take(&settings).Error; err != nil && !errors.Is(err, gorm.ErrRecordNotFound) {
+			return err
+		}
+		columns := []string{"updated_at"}
+		for _, field := range fields {
+			if field.value != nil {
+				field.apply(&settings, *field.value)
+				columns = append(columns, field.column)
+			}
+		}
+		settings.UserID = userID
+		// The row lock serializes existing rows. Two first saves can both miss
+		// the row, so the upsert writes only the supplied columns and keeps
+		// whatever the other save stored.
+		if err := tx.Clauses(clause.OnConflict{Columns: []clause.Column{{Name: "user_id"}}, DoUpdates: clause.AssignmentColumns(columns)}).Create(&settings).Error; err != nil {
+			return err
+		}
+		return tx.Where("user_id = ?", userID).Take(&settings).Error
+	})
+	return settings, err
+}
+
+func validPrivacyAudience(key, audience string) bool {
+	return slices.Contains(PrivacyAudiences[key], audience)
+}

+// Package agentcommentservice owns the site-wide and per-topic Agent comment
+// policy. The global switch is hot-read page configuration; the per-topic flag
+// lives on topics.agent_comment_disabled and is maintained from the admin
+// "Agent comment policy" panel.
+package agentcommentservice
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/pageConfig"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/topics"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/hotdataserve"
+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+// ErrAgentCommentDisabled 全站或该主题已禁止 Agent 评论；这是业务拒绝，
+// 与凭据/可见性错误（inaccessible）区分，便于 Agent 判断不应重试。
+var ErrAgentCommentDisabled = errors.New("agent comments disabled")
+
+// AllowsAgentComment 判断该主题当前是否允许 Agent 发表评论。
+func AllowsAgentComment(topic topics.Entity) bool {
+	if !hotdataserve.GetAgentCommentPolicyConfigCache().AllowAgentComments {
+		return false
+	}
+	return !topic.AgentCommentDisabled
+}
+
+// SetTopicPolicy 管理端设置单个主题的 Agent 评论禁止标记。
+func SetTopicPolicy(topicID uint64, disabled bool) error {
+	return topics.UpdateAgentCommentDisabled(topicID, disabled)
+}
+
+// CheckNewCommentTx runs only after idempotent replay has been resolved. The
+// topic row is already locked by write authorization; the global row stays
+// locked through commit, serializing successful writes with admin saves.
+func CheckNewCommentTx(tx *gorm.DB, topicID uint64) error {
+	topic, err := topics.GetUnscopedTx(tx, topicID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if topic.AgentCommentDisabled {
+		return ErrAgentCommentDisabled
+	}
+	config, err := pageConfig.LockAgentCommentPolicyTx(tx)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if !config.AllowAgentComments {
+		return ErrAgentCommentDisabled
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func SaveGlobalPolicy(config pageConfig.AgentCommentPolicyConfig) error {
+	if err := db.Connect().Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error { return pageConfig.SaveAgentCommentPolicyTx(tx, config) }); err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	hotdataserve.ClearAgentCommentPolicyConfigCache()
+	return nil
+}

+func managementUser(tx *gorm.DB, userID uint64) (users.EntityComplete, bool) {
+	var user users.EntityComplete
+	err := tx.First(&user, userID).Error
+	return user, err == nil && user.Id != 0 && user.ActorType == users.ActorTypeHuman && user.IsFrozen == users.StatusNormal && user.IsActivated == users.ActivationSuccess
+}
+
+// CanManage preserves bot login isolation: the human creator or station admin manages it.
+func CanManage(userID, agentID uint64) bool {
+	return CanManageTx(db.Connect(), userID, agentID)
+}
+
+// CanManageTx reads live ownership and account state in the caller's transaction.
+func CanManageTx(tx *gorm.DB, userID, agentID uint64) bool {
+	user, ok := managementUser(tx, userID)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if user.RoleId == 1 || permission.CheckRoleTx(tx, user.RoleId, permission.Admin) {
+		return true
+	}
+	agent := agents.GetByUserIDWithDB(tx, agentID)
+	return agent != nil && agent.CreatedBy == userID
+}
+
+func CanAccessManagement(userID uint64) bool {
+	tx := db.Connect()
+	user, ok := managementUser(tx, userID)
+	if !ok {
+		return false
+	}
+	if user.RoleId == 1 || permission.CheckRoleTx(tx, user.RoleId, permission.Admin) {
+		return true
+	}
+	var count int64
+	return tx.Model(&agents.Entity{}).Where("created_by = ?", userID).Count(&count).Error == nil && count > 0
+}

+package feedservice
+
+import (
+	"context"
+	"sync"
+	"time"
+
+	db "github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/bundles/connect/dbconnect"

+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/topics"
+)
+
+type MetricRow struct {
+	WeightVariant string `json:"weightVariant"`
+	Capability    string `json:"capability"`
+	RankHash      string `json:"rankHash"`
+	Day           string `json:"day"`
+	Feed          string `json:"feed"`
+	Hash          string `json:"hash"`
+	Experiment    string `json:"experiment"`
+	Variant       string `json:"variant"`
+	Metric        string `json:"metric"`
+	Count         int64  `json:"count"`
+}
+type Summary struct {
+	Enabled        bool            `json:"enabled"`
+	RankingReady   bool            `json:"rankingReady"`
+	MetricsEnabled bool            `json:"metricsEnabled"`
+	Rollout        int             `json:"rolloutPercent"`
+	Retention      int             `json:"rawRetentionDays"`
+	ParamsHash     string          `json:"paramsHash"`
+	Rows           []MetricRow     `json:"rows"`
+	Truncated      bool            `json:"truncated"`
+	Periods        []PeriodSummary `json:"periods"`
+	Health         map[string]any  `json:"health"`
+}
+
+var summaryMu sync.Mutex
+var cachedSummary Summary
+var summaryAt time.Time
+
+// The admin view reads anonymous aggregates only. It never reconstructs or
+// exposes individual traces, candidate samples, assignments or activity days.
+func GetSummary(ctx context.Context) (Summary, error) {
+	summaryMu.Lock()
+	defer summaryMu.Unlock()
+	if time.Since(summaryAt) < 60*time.Second {
+		return cachedSummary, nil
+	}
+	cfg := feedconfig.Current()
+	var rows []feed.MetricsDaily
+	if err := db.ConnectContext(ctx).Where("day >= ?", localDay(time.Now().Add(-7*24*time.Hour))).Order("day DESC").Order("feed,hash,rank_hash,experiment,variant,weight_variant,capability,metric").Limit(1001).Find(&rows).Error; err != nil {
+		return Summary{}, err
+	}
+	s := Summary{Enabled: cfg.Enabled, RankingReady: feedconfig.RankReady(), MetricsEnabled: cfg.Metrics, Rollout: cfg.Rollout, Retention: cfg.RetentionDays, ParamsHash: cfg.Hash, Rows: []MetricRow{}, Truncated: len(rows) > 1000, Health: TelemetryHealth()}
+	s.Health["parameters"] = cfg
+	for _, r := range rows[:min(len(rows), 1000)] {
+		s.Rows = append(s.Rows, MetricRow{WeightVariant: r.WeightVariant, Day: r.Day, Feed: r.Feed, Hash: r.Hash, Experiment: r.Experiment, Variant: r.Variant, Metric: r.Metric, Count: r.Count, Capability: r.Capability, RankHash: r.RankHash})
+	}
+	var periods []feed.ExperimentPeriod
+	if err := db.ConnectContext(ctx).Order("started_at DESC").Limit(20).Find(&periods).Error; err != nil {
+		return Summary{}, err
+	}
+	s.Periods = []PeriodSummary{}
+	for _, p := range periods {
+		s.Periods = append(s.Periods, PeriodSummary{ID: p.ID, Hash: p.Hash, EnrollUntil: p.EnrollUntil, AnalyzeAt: p.AnalyzeAt, Aborted: p.Aborted, AssignedControl: p.AssignedControl, AssignedTreatment: p.AssignedTreatment, Result: p.Result})
+	}
+	cachedSummary = s
+	summaryAt = time.Now()
+	return s, nil
+}
+
+type PeriodSummary struct {
+	ID                string    `json:"id"`
+	Hash              string    `json:"hash"`
+	EnrollUntil       time.Time `json:"enrollUntil"`
+	AnalyzeAt         time.Time `json:"analyzeAt"`
+	Aborted           string    `json:"aborted"`
+	AssignedControl   int64     `json:"assignedControl"`
+	AssignedTreatment int64     `json:"assignedTreatment"`
+	Result            string    `json:"result"`
+}
+
+// ExplainRank prints current aggregate inputs/results, never raw actor facts.
+func ExplainRank(ctx context.Context, id uint64) (map[string]any, error) {
+	cfg := feedconfig.Current()
+	ctx, cancel := context.WithTimeout(ctx, time.Duration(cfg.QueryTimeoutMS)*time.Millisecond)
+	defer cancel()
+	topic, err := topics.RankTopic(ctx, id)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	input, err := rankInput(ctx, id, topic)
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	return map[string]any{"topicId": id, "paramsHash": cfg.Hash, "rankHash": cfg.RankHash, "materializedHot": topic.RankScore, "materializedDaily": topic.DailyScore, "current": ScoreRankWithRules(input, time.Now(), cfg.Rules), "firstPublicEstimated": topic.FirstPublicEstimated, "limitation": "Current public state only; this does not reconstruct a historical candidate pool or causal effect."}, nil
+}

+package httpnotifyservice
+
+import (
+	"strconv"

+	"unicode"
+)
+
+// 审批种类与快捷动作（issue #1049）。
+const (
+	ApprovalKindReview = "review" // 内容真正进入人工审核队列
+	ApprovalKindReport = "report" // 新举报
+	ApprovalKindAppeal = "appeal" // 新申诉：作者对审核结论提出复核
+
+	ApprovalActionApprove = "approve" // 待审内容：通过并公开
+	ApprovalActionReject  = "reject"  // 待审内容：拒绝
+	ApprovalActionBan     = "ban"     // 举报：封禁目标并结案
+	ApprovalActionHide    = "hide"    // 课评举报：隐藏评价并结案
+	ApprovalActionDismiss = "dismiss" // 举报：驳回
+)
+
+// ApprovalPayload 审批事件的 generic 负载（data 字段）与卡片通道的渲染输入。
+// BaseURI 用于把站内路径拼成绝对地址。
+type ApprovalPayload struct {
+	BaseURI  string   `json:"baseUri"`
+	Approval Approval `json:"approval"`
+}
+
+// Approval 待人工审批的安全摘要：生产者已完成匿名/隐私裁剪，渲染器不得再回库
+// 拼接作者等身份信息。所有 URL 字段均为站内路径。
+type Approval struct {
+	ID         string `json:"id"`         // 稳定审批标识（待审内容含送审版本 ID），亦为投递去重键
+	Kind       string `json:"kind"`       // review | report | appeal
+	TargetType string `json:"targetType"` // topic | post | chat_message | course_review
+	TargetID   uint64 `json:"targetId"`
+	ReportID   uint64 `json:"reportId,omitempty"`
+	AppealID   uint64 `json:"appealId,omitempty"`
+	TopicID    uint64 `json:"topicId,omitempty"`
+	// Reason 举报为原因代码（spam/abuse/...）；人工审核为触发来源（sensitive_word/ai）。
+	Reason     string          `json:"reason,omitempty"`
+	Note       string          `json:"note,omitempty"`
+	Title      string          `json:"title,omitempty"`
+	Excerpt    string          `json:"excerpt,omitempty"`
+	Anonymous  bool            `json:"anonymous"`
+	Author     *ApprovalAuthor `json:"author,omitempty"`
+	Categories []string        `json:"categories,omitempty"`
+	Edited     bool            `json:"edited,omitempty"`
+	// Version 送审版本 ID；快捷动作绑定该版本，作者改稿后旧卡片失效。
+	Version       string           `json:"version,omitempty"`
+	CreatedAt     string           `json:"createdAt"`
+	TargetURL     string           `json:"targetUrl,omitempty"`
+	ModerationURL string           `json:"moderationUrl"`
+	Actions       []ApprovalAction `json:"actions"`
+}
+
+// ApprovalAuthor 可公开披露的作者信息（匿名内容不输出）。
+type ApprovalAuthor struct {
+	ID          uint64 `json:"id"`
+	DisplayName string `json:"displayName"`
+	URL         string `json:"url"`
+}
+
+// ApprovalAction 快捷动作：URL 指向 Hub 确认页（GET 无副作用），登录并通过权限
+// 复核后由用户显式提交。
+type ApprovalAction struct {
+	Action string `json:"action"`
+	URL    string `json:"url"`
+}
+
+// approvalActionLabel 快捷动作文案：申诉的通过/拒绝针对申诉本身，与待审内容区分。
+func approvalActionLabel(kind, action string) string {
+	if kind == ApprovalKindAppeal {
+		switch action {
+		case ApprovalActionApprove:
+			return "通过申诉并公开"
+		case ApprovalActionReject:
+			return "驳回申诉"
+		}
+	}
+	return approvalActionLabels[action]
+}
+
+// approvalSubject 编号行：举报与申诉带各自编号，其后是目标类型与 ID。
+func approvalSubject(a Approval, target string) string {
+	subject := target + " #" + strconv.FormatUint(a.TargetID, 10)
+	switch {
+	case a.ReportID > 0:
+		subject = "举报 #" + strconv.FormatUint(a.ReportID, 10) + " · " + subject
+	case a.AppealID > 0:
+		subject = "申诉 #" + strconv.FormatUint(a.AppealID, 10) + " · " + subject
+	}
+	return subject
+}
+
+// appealPrivacyNote 申诉卡片的固定说明：外部群只收到安全引用。
+const appealPrivacyNote = "被拒内容、作者身份和申诉说明不会发到外部群，请打开确认页或版主工作台查看后处理。"
+
+// SafeText 规范化外部展示文本：去控制字符、折叠空白并按 rune 截断，避免用户输入
+// 破坏卡片结构或撑爆消息体。
+func SafeText(value string, maxRunes int) string {
+	var b strings.Builder
+	space := false
+	for _, r := range value {
+		if unicode.IsSpace(r) {
+			space = true
+			continue
+		}
+		if unicode.IsControl(r) || r == '\uFEFF' {
+			continue
+		}
+		if space && b.Len() > 0 {
+			b.WriteByte(' ')
+		}
+		space = false
+		b.WriteRune(r)
+	}
+	text := b.String()
+	if runes := []rune(text); maxRunes > 0 && len(runes) > maxRunes {
+		text = string(runes[:maxRunes-1]) + "…"
+	}
+	return text
+}

+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/taskQueue"
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/hotdataserve"
+)
+
+func TestFeishuRetryRefreshesTimestampAndCurrentSecret(t *testing.T) {
+	oldKey := preferences.GetString("app.signingKey", "")
+	preferences.Set("app.signingKey", "httpnotify-retry-test-key-0123456789")
+	t.Cleanup(func() { preferences.Set("app.signingKey", oldKey) })
+	var received []byte
+	server := httptest.NewServer(http.HandlerFunc(func(w http.ResponseWriter, r *http.Request) {
+		received, _ = io.ReadAll(r.Body)
+		_, _ = w.Write([]byte(`{"code":0}`))
+	}))
+	t.Cleanup(server.Close)
+	if err := dbconnect.Connect().AutoMigrate(&pageConfig.Entity{}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	entity := pageConfig.GetByPageType(pageConfig.HttpNotify)
+	original := entity.Config
+	t.Cleanup(func() {
+		entity.Config = original
+		pageConfig.CreateOrSave(&entity)
+		hotdataserve.ClearHttpNotifyConfigCache()
+	})
+	sealed, err := securestore.EncryptPurpose("current-secret", securestore.HttpNotifySecretPurpose)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	entity.PageType = pageConfig.HttpNotify
+	entity.Config = jsonopt.Encode(pageConfig.HttpNotifyStorageConfig{Enabled: true, Endpoints: []pageConfig.HttpNotifyStorageEndpoint{{Id: "retry-signing", URL: server.URL, Enabled: true, ChannelType: pageConfig.HttpNotifyChannelFeishu, SecretEncrypted: sealed, Events: []string{EventReportPostCreated}}}})
+	pageConfig.CreateOrSave(&entity)
+	hotdataserve.ClearHttpNotifyConfigCache()
+	oldTime := time.Now().Add(-2 * time.Hour)
+	body, err := (feishuChannel{}).encode(pageConfig.HttpNotifyEndpoint{Secret: "old-secret"}, Alternative{}, testApproval(), oldTime)
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	payload, err := json.Marshal(deliveryRetryTask{EndpointKey: "id:retry-signing", ChannelType: pageConfig.HttpNotifyChannelFeishu, Event: EventReportPostCreated, Timestamp: oldTime.Unix(), Body: body, ExpiresAt: time.Now().Add(time.Hour).Unix()})
+	if err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	if err := RunDeliveryRetryTask(context.Background(), &taskQueue.Entity{TaskJson: string(payload)}); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	var decoded struct {
+		Timestamp string          `json:"timestamp"`
+		Sign      string          `json:"sign"`
+		Card      json.RawMessage `json:"card"`
+	}
+	if err := json.Unmarshal(received, &decoded); err != nil {
+		t.Fatal(err)
+	}
+	timestamp, err := strconv.ParseInt(decoded.Timestamp, 10, 64)
+	if err != nil || time.Now().Unix()-timestamp > 5 || decoded.Sign != feishuSign(decoded.Timestamp, "current-secret") {
+		t.Fatalf("retry used stale signing credentials: timestamp=%s sign=%s", decoded.Timestamp, decoded.Sign)
+	}
+	if len(decoded.Card) == 0 {
+		t.Fatal("retry lost approval card")
+	}
+}

+package httpnotifyservice
+
+import (
+	"errors"
+	"time"
+
+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/pageConfig"
+)
+
+// EventWebhookTest 管理端「测试发送」的事件名：不能订阅，只在手动测试时发送（issue #1049）。
+const EventWebhookTest = "webhook.test"
+
+// WebhookTestData generic 通道测试事件的数据。
+type WebhookTestData struct {
+	BaseURI      string `json:"baseUri"`
+	EndpointID   string `json:"endpointId"`
+	EndpointName string `json:"endpointName"`
+	Message      string `json:"message"`
+}
+
+// SendTest 同步向单个 Endpoint 发送一条测试消息，返回可展示给管理员的失败原因
+// （已去掉请求 URL，飞书地址是凭据）。不受总开关、启用状态和订阅事件限制，
+// 也不计入失败次数与异常停用：测试是为了在保存前排查问题。
+func SendTest(endpoint pageConfig.HttpNotifyEndpoint, baseURI string, now time.Time) error {
+	channel := channelFor(endpoint)
+	body, err := channel.testBody(endpoint, baseURI, now)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	req, err := channel.buildRequest(endpoint, EventWebhookTest, deliveryID(), now.Unix(), body)
+	if err != nil {
+		return errors.New(deliveryErrorMessage(err))
+	}
+	resp, err := sendRequest(req, endpointTimeout(endpoint))
+	if err != nil {
+		return errors.New(deliveryErrorMessage(err))
+	}
+	defer resp.Body.Close()
+	if err := channel.checkResponse(resp); err != nil {
+		return errors.New(deliveryErrorMessage(err))
+	}
+	return nil
+}

+	}

+package tokenservice
+
+import (
+	"crypto/hmac"
+	"crypto/sha256"
+	"encoding/base64"
+	"encoding/json"
+	"errors"
+	"strings"
+	"time"
+)
+
+// 版主快捷审批链接（issue #1049）：飞书等通知卡片里的按钮只携带签名 token，
+// 打开 Hub 确认页后由登录用户显式提交。token 只证明“链接由本站签发且未被篡改、
+// 仍在有效期内”，绝不代表点击者有审核权限——执行时必须按真实会话重新授权。
+
+// ModerationActionTTL 快捷审批链接有效期。
+const ModerationActionTTL = 24 * time.Hour
+
+// 快捷审批的目标种类。
+const (
+	ModerationActionSubjectReviewTopic = "review.topic" // 待人工审核的话题（ID = topic id）
+	ModerationActionSubjectReviewPost  = "review.post"  // 待人工审核的回复（ID = post id）
+	ModerationActionSubjectReport      = "report"       // 待处理举报（ID = report id）
+	ModerationActionSubjectAppeal      = "appeal"       // 待复核的申诉（ID = appeal id）
+)
+
+// moderationActionPurpose 派生签名密钥的用途标签：与重置密码/激活 JWT（直接用
+// app.signingKey）隔离，任何一方的 token 都不能被另一方接受。
+const moderationActionPurpose = "yourtj-moderation-action-token"
+
+const moderationActionPrefix = "v1."
+
+var (
+	// ErrModerationActionInvalid token 结构、签名或字段非法。
+	ErrModerationActionInvalid = errors.New("moderation action token invalid")
+	// ErrModerationActionExpired token 签名有效但已过期（返回的 claims 仍可用于引导到工作台）。
+	ErrModerationActionExpired = errors.New("moderation action token expired")
+)
+
+// ModerationActionClaims 快捷审批链接绑定的目标、动作与版本。
+// Version 对待审内容是送审版本 ID（post_revisions.id），作者改稿后旧链接失效；
+// 举报为空（举报是否仍待处理由 status 复核）。
+type ModerationActionClaims struct {
+	Subject string `json:"s"`
+	ID      uint64 `json:"i"`
+	Action  string `json:"a"`
+	Version string `json:"v,omitempty"`
+	Expires int64  `json:"e"`
+}
+
+// IssueModerationAction 签发快捷审批 token：v1.<base64url(payload)>.<base64url(hmac)>。
+func IssueModerationAction(claims ModerationActionClaims, now time.Time) (string, error) {
+	if claims.Subject == "" || claims.ID == 0 || claims.Action == "" {
+		return "", ErrModerationActionInvalid
+	}
+	key, err := moderationActionKey()
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	claims.Expires = now.Add(ModerationActionTTL).Unix()
+	payload, err := json.Marshal(claims)
+	if err != nil {
+		return "", err
+	}
+	body := base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(payload)
+	return moderationActionPrefix + body + "." + base64.RawURLEncoding.EncodeToString(moderationActionMAC(key, body)), nil
+}
+
+// ParseModerationAction 校验签名（常量时间比较）与有效期。签名有效但过期时返回
+// claims 与 ErrModerationActionExpired。
+func ParseModerationAction(token string, now time.Time) (ModerationActionClaims, error) {
+	var claims ModerationActionClaims
+	rest, ok := strings.CutPrefix(strings.TrimSpace(token), moderationActionPrefix)
+	if !ok {
+		return claims, ErrModerationActionInvalid
+	}
+	body, sig, ok := strings.Cut(rest, ".")
+	if !ok || body == "" || sig == "" {
+		return claims, ErrModerationActionInvalid
+	}
+	key, err := moderationActionKey()
+	if err != nil {
+		return claims, err
+	}
+	gotMAC, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(sig)
+	if err != nil || !hmac.Equal(gotMAC, moderationActionMAC(key, body)) {
+		return claims, ErrModerationActionInvalid
+	}
+	payload, err := base64.RawURLEncoding.DecodeString(body)
+	if err != nil || json.Unmarshal(payload, &claims) != nil || claims.Subject == "" || claims.ID == 0 || claims.Action == "" {
+		return ModerationActionClaims{}, ErrModerationActionInvalid
+	}
+	if now.Unix() > claims.Expires {
+		return claims, ErrModerationActionExpired
+	}
+	return claims, nil
+}
+
+func moderationActionKey() ([]byte, error) {
+	base, err := signingKey()
+	if err != nil {
+		return nil, err
+	}
+	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, base)
+	mac.Write([]byte(moderationActionPurpose))
+	return mac.Sum(nil), nil
+}
+
+func moderationActionMAC(key []byte, body string) []byte {
+	mac := hmac.New(sha256.New, key)
+	mac.Write([]byte(moderationActionPrefix))
+	mac.Write([]byte(body))
+	return mac.Sum(nil)
+}

+	"github.com/YourTongji/YourTJ-Hub/apps/gooseforum/app/models/forum/topics"

+	"gorm.io/gorm"
+)
+
+var (
+	ErrAgentRepliesDisabled = errors.New("topic disables agent replies")
+	ErrSettingDenied        = errors.New("topic reply setting cannot be changed")
+)
+
+// CheckReplyTx requires the caller to hold the topic write lock until commit.
+// The setting applies to bot identities regardless of transport or role.
+func CheckReplyTx(tx *gorm.DB, topic topics.Entity, authorID uint64) error {
+	if !topic.AgentRepliesDisabled {
+		return nil
+	}
+	author, err := users.GetActorTx(tx, authorID)
+	if err != nil {
+		return err
+	}
+	if author.IsBot() {
+		return ErrAgentRepliesDisabled
+	}
+	return nil
+}
+
+func SetAgentRepliesDisabled(ctx context.Context, topicID, actorID uint64, disabled bool) (topic topics.Entity, err error) {
+	err = db.ConnectContext(ctx).Transaction(func(tx *gorm.DB) error {
+		var readErr error
+		topic, readErr = topics.GetForUpdateTx(tx, topicID)
+		if readErr != nil {
+			return readErr
+		}
+		if topic.UserId != actorID || topic.TopicType != topics.TopicTypeForum || topic.VisibilityStatus != topics.VisibilityActive {
+			return ErrSettingDenied
+		}
+		return topics.UpdateAgentRepliesDisabledTx(tx, topicID, disabled)
+	})
+	return
+}

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/docs/frontend/ui-spec.md b/apps/gooseforum/docs/frontend/ui-spec.md

--- a/apps/gooseforum/docs/frontend/ui-spec.md
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/docs/frontend/ui-spec.md
@@ -154,10 +154,11 @@ Public SPA navigation rules:
 - Do not clear shell header state before the next page is ready to render.
 - Animate the main content area only when the page identity changes, such as topic list to topic detail.
 - Do not animate the whole page for same-view filter changes. Stable regions such as announcements, tabs, headers, and list frames should stay still when only list data changes.
 - The homepage announcement panel may collapse to a single title row. Collapse/expand is user intent, not a data effect: announcement/list data refreshes never animate the panel; the transition plays only on the user's toggle and respects `prefers-reduced-motion`. While collapsed the announcement HTML is not rendered (`v-if` removes it from the accessibility tree), and the expand control exposes `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` pointing at the panel with a visible focus state. The collapse preference persists in `localStorage` and is independent of the announcement read state.
 - The collapsed announcement keeps a full-row click target with a pointer cursor; hover coloring is confined to the chevron, while keyboard focus outlines the row. A blank title shows the localized expand action so the row remains understandable without announcement metadata.
+- With multiple announcements the expanded panel reserves the tallest announcement's height: auto-rotation and dot selection switch which announcement is visible without changing the panel height or moving the content below it, and without adding height motion. Non-active announcements stay out of the accessibility tree and tab order (`aria-hidden` plus `inert`).
 - Let the component that owns the changed data provide local motion when it does not disturb document height. For same-view topic sort changes, do not animate the whole topic list in or out; prefer direct data replacement plus stable tab/loading feedback.
 - Keep the previous page visible until the next payload and component are ready.
 - Use subtle opacity and small vertical movement for page content. Avoid scale, large movement, or whole-shell animation.
 - Sidebar active state may transition color/background, but must not change item size or position.
 - Loading indicators should appear only after a short delay and remain visible long enough to avoid flicker.
@@ -257,11 +258,16 @@ optional right rail
 
 Rules:
 
 - The title is prominent but not oversized.
 - Topic body and editor preview must share prose behavior.
-- Post actions should be available without visually dominating the stream.
+- Show each topic fact once; header metadata owns reply and view counts; like counts also appear on the guest floating login entry, while the right rail is for participant context.
+- The first post must not repeat topic-level reply, like, bookmark, share, or report controls in its per-post action strip; later replies keep their own post-level actions.
+- The topic action bar and the floating control pill are synced mirrors: the pill carries the same topic-level actions (like, bookmark, watch, plus moderation and delete where permitted) driven by the same state and handlers, so the two entry points never drift. The pill mounts outside the post stream, so topic-level actions stay reachable when the first post is not loaded (deep-link windows). For guests the pill shows a like button with the current count and a "log in to join" reply entry instead of the authenticated mirror actions.
+- Topic and post reporting require sign-in; do not render report controls for guests, because the report API rejects anonymous submissions.
+- The floating control pill must not render as an empty shell: it always keeps at least the reply entry or a mirrored action visible at every viewport.
+- The reply entry point is floating at every viewport; the desktop topic action bar provides a synchronized reply entry. When the first post is absent, the authenticated floating pill also provides topic share and report actions (report remains hidden for authors and removed topics).
 - A user's own posts may expose edit actions when permissions allow.
 - Errors from post creation or editing must be shown near the action that failed.
