evidence.title: apps/gooseforum/resource/test/avatar-click-behavior.test.ts
evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/avatar-click-behavior.test.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/avatar-click-behavior.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..7b8c1119b
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/avatar-click-behavior.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,253 @@
+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { beforeEach, describe, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+
+// happy-dom 20 把 localStorage 定义为原型 getter，测试环境缺失该全局（与
+// quick-publish-draft-guard.test.ts 同一处理）：提供最小内存实现，仅为断言持久化与失败回退。
+const memoryStorage = new Map<string, string>()
+Object.defineProperty(window, 'localStorage', {
+  configurable: true,
+  value: {
+    getItem: (key: string) => memoryStorage.get(key) ?? null,
+    setItem: (key: string, value: string) => {
+      memoryStorage.set(key, String(value))
+    },
+    removeItem: (key: string) => {
+      memoryStorage.delete(key)
+    },
+    clear: () => {
+      memoryStorage.clear()
+    },
+    key: (index: number) => Array.from(memoryStorage.keys())[index] ?? null,
+    get length() {
+      return memoryStorage.size
+    },
+  },
+})
+
+const storageKey = 'goose:avatar-click-behavior'
+
+interface TargetUser {
+  id: number
+  username: string
+  avatarUrl: string
+  publicUid?: string
+}
+
+const alice: TargetUser = { id: 42, username: 'alice', avatarUrl: '' }
+const anonymousPersona: TargetUser = { ...alice, publicUid: 'persona-uid' }
+
+async function loadModules() {
+  const behavior = await import('../src/runtime/avatar-click-behavior')
+  const events = await import('../src/runtime/user-card-events')
+  return { showUserCard: events.showUserCard, prefs: behavior.useAvatarClickBehavior() }
+}
+
+interface ClickInit {
+  button?: number
+  metaKey?: boolean
+  ctrlKey?: boolean
+  shiftKey?: boolean
+  altKey?: boolean
+}
+
+/**
+ * 在带 href 的锚点上派发一次点击（与全站 13 处调用点同构），
+ * 同时监听卡片事件与 document 冒泡（全站点击拦截器的位置）。
+ */
+function clickTargetAnchor(
+  showUserCard: (user: TargetUser, event: MouseEvent) => void,
+  user: TargetUser,
+  init: ClickInit = {},
+) {
+  const anchor = document.createElement('a')
+  anchor.href = user.publicUid ? `/a/${user.publicUid}` : `/u/${user.id}`
+  document.body.appendChild(anchor)
+
+  const cardListener = vi.fn()
+  const documentListener = vi.fn()
+  window.addEventListener('goose:user-card-show', cardListener)
+  document.addEventListener('click', documentListener)
+  anchor.addEventListener('click', (event) => showUserCard(user, event))
+
+  const event = new MouseEvent('click', {
+    bubbles: true,
+    cancelable: true,
+    button: init.button ?? 0,
+    metaKey: init.metaKey ?? false,
+    ctrlKey: init.ctrlKey ?? false,
+    shiftKey: init.shiftKey ?? false,
+    altKey: init.altKey ?? false,
+  })
+  anchor.dispatchEvent(event)
+  window.removeEventListener('goose:user-card-show', cardListener)
+  document.removeEventListener('click', documentListener)
+
+  return { event, cardListener, documentListener }
+}
+
+const modifierCases: Array<[string, ClickInit]> = [
+  ['中键', { button: 1 }],
+  ['⌘+点击', { metaKey: true }],
+  ['Ctrl+点击', { ctrlKey: true }],
+  ['Shift+点击', { shiftKey: true }],
+  ['Alt+点击', { altKey: true }],
+]
+
+describe('头像点击行为偏好（issue #1134）', () => {
+  beforeEach(() => {
+    window.localStorage.clear()
+    document.body.innerHTML = ''
+    vi.resetModules()
+  })
+
+  test('默认偏好（无本地值）：点击头像弹用户卡片并阻止默认导航', async () => {
+    const { showUserCard } = await loadModules()
+
+    const { event, cardListener, documentListener } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+
+    expect(cardListener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+    expect(event.defaultPrevented).toBe(true)
+    expect(documentListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  test('直达偏好：不弹卡片也不拦截，锚点 href 交还浏览器与全站点击拦截器', async () => {
+    const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+    prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')
+
+    const { event, cardListener, documentListener } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+
+    expect(cardListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(event.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)
+    expect(documentListener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+  })
+
+  test('偏好切换即时生效：同一会话内先弹卡片、切换后直达，无需刷新', async () => {
+    const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+
+    const before = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+    expect(before.cardListener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+
+    prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('profile')
+
+    const after = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+    expect(after.cardListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(after.event.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test.each(modifierCases)('修饰键语义在两种偏好下都保留：%s 交还浏览器默认新标签行为', async (_label, init) => {
+    for (const behavior of ['card', 'profile'] as const) {
+      vi.resetModules()
+      const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+      prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior(behavior)
+
+      const { event, cardListener } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice, init)
+
+      expect(cardListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+      expect(event.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)
+    }
+  })
+
+  test('匿名公开身份（publicUid）在两种偏好下都跟随 /a/{uid} 链接、不弹卡片', async () => {
+    for (const behavior of ['card', 'profile'] as const) {
+      vi.resetModules()
+      const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+      prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior(behavior)
+
+      const { event, cardListener } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, anonymousPersona)
+
+      expect(cardListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+      expect(event.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)
+    }
+  })
+
+  test('偏好写入 localStorage，重开浏览器（重新加载模块）后仍为直达', async () => {
+    const { prefs } = await loadModules()
+    prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')
+    expect(window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey)).toBe('profile')
+
+    vi.resetModules()
+    const reloaded = await loadModules()
+    expect(reloaded.prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('profile')
+  })
+
+  test('无值或非法持久化值回退默认卡片模式', async () => {
+    window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, 'bogus')
+    const invalid = await loadModules()
+    expect(invalid.prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+
+    vi.resetModules()
+    window.localStorage.clear()
+    const missing = await loadModules()
+    expect(missing.prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+  })
+
+  test('localStorage 不可用（受限浏览）时读取回退默认、写入不抛错且即时生效', async () => {
+    const getItem = vi.spyOn(window.localStorage, 'getItem').mockImplementation(() => {
+      throw new Error('storage disabled')
+    })
+    const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+    getItem.mockRestore()
+
+    const setItem = vi.spyOn(window.localStorage, 'setItem').mockImplementation(() => {
+      throw new Error('storage disabled')
+    })
+    expect(() => prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')).not.toThrow()
+    setItem.mockRestore()
+
+    // 写入失败不影响本次会话的分流
+    const { cardListener } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+    expect(cardListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  })
+
+  test('恢复默认：清除持久化并回到卡片模式', async () => {
+    const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+    prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')
+
+    prefs.restoreAvatarClickBehavior()
+
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+    expect(window.localStorage.getItem(storageKey)).toBeNull()
+    const { cardListener } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+    expect(cardListener).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(1)
+  })
+
+  test('跨标签页同步：其他标签页改写偏好后本标签页经 storage 事件即时跟随', async () => {
+    const { showUserCard, prefs } = await loadModules()
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+
+    // storage 事件只在其他文档触发，这里直接派发以模拟另一标签页写入。
+    window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, 'profile')
+    window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: storageKey, newValue: 'profile' }))
+
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('profile')
+    const { cardListener, event } = clickTargetAnchor(showUserCard, alice)
+    expect(cardListener).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+    expect(event.defaultPrevented).toBe(false)
+  })
+
+  test('跨标签页恢复默认：removeItem 与 clear（key 为 null）都回到卡片模式', async () => {
+    const { prefs } = await loadModules()
+    prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')
+
+    window.localStorage.removeItem(storageKey)
+    window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: storageKey, newValue: null }))
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+
+    prefs.setAvatarClickBehavior('profile')
+    window.localStorage.clear()
+    window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: null }))
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+  })
+
+  test('无关 key 的 storage 事件不改动本标签页偏好', async () => {
+    const { prefs } = await loadModules()
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+
+    window.localStorage.setItem(storageKey, 'profile')
+    window.dispatchEvent(new StorageEvent('storage', { key: 'goose:shell-sidebar-collapsed', newValue: '1' }))
+
+    expect(prefs.avatarClickBehavior.value).toBe('card')
+  })
+})

+  await page.route('**/api/admin/badges',route=>route.fulfill({json:{code:0,result:[badge]}}))

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { createI18n } from 'vue-i18n'
+import { expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import zh from '../src/locales/zh'
+import CampusMapMinePanel from '../src/site/components/CampusMapMinePanel.vue'
+
+const api = vi.hoisted(() => ({ status: vi.fn(), dataset: vi.fn() }))
+vi.mock('@/runtime/campus-api', () => ({ campusAPI: api }))
+
+it('retains a multi-location course and requires an explicit location choice', async () => {
+  api.status.mockResolvedValue({ binding: { revision: 'test-binding', needsAuthorization: false } })
+  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
+    timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
+  }).formatToParts(new Date())
+  const part = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => parts.find(item => item.type === type)?.value ?? ''
+  const date = `${part('year')}-${part('month')}-${part('day')}`
+  const event = {
+    name: '测试课程', campus: '四平路校区', room: '单周北115，双周南203，实验室',
+    day: 1, start: 1, end: 2, weeks: [1, 2], teacher: '', credits: '',
+  }
+  api.dataset.mockImplementation(async (key: string) => ({
+    key, status: 'ready', metrics: [], events: key === 'today' ? [event] : [],
+    ...(key === 'today' ? { teachingDay: { date } } : {}),
+  }))
+  const north = { campusId: 'siping', featureId: 'north' }
+  const south = { campusId: 'siping', featureId: 'south' }
+  const resolveLocation = vi.fn().mockResolvedValue([
+    { raw: '单周北115', building: '北', room: '115', condition: '单周', target: north },
+    { raw: '双周南203', building: '南', room: '203', condition: '双周', target: south },
+    { raw: '实验室', building: '实验室', room: '', condition: '' },
+  ])
+  const wrapper = mount(CampusMapMinePanel, {
+    props: { authenticated: true, resolveLocation },
+    global: { plugins: [createI18n({ legacy: false, locale: 'zh', messages: { zh } })] },
+  })
+  await flushPromises()
+  await wrapper.get('.atlas-mine__course').trigger('click')
+  await flushPromises()
+
+  expect(wrapper.get('.atlas-mine__selected').text()).toContain(event.room)
+  expect(wrapper.emitted('select')?.at(-1)).toEqual([null])
+  const choices = wrapper.findAll('.atlas-location-choices button')
+  expect(choices).toHaveLength(3)
+  expect(choices[0]!.text()).toContain('单周')
+  expect(choices[1]!.text()).toContain('双周')
+  expect(choices[2]!.attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+  expect(choices[2]!.text()).toContain('未定位')
+  await choices[1]!.trigger('click')
+  expect(wrapper.emitted('select')?.at(-1)).toEqual([south])
+
+  window.dispatchEvent(new Event('goose:session-cleared'))
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(wrapper.find('.atlas-location-choices').exists()).toBe(false)
+  expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain(event.room)
+  expect(wrapper.emitted('select')?.at(-1)).toEqual([null])
+  wrapper.unmount()
+})
+
+it('ignores the first deferred location lookup after selecting A then B then A again', async () => {
+  api.status.mockResolvedValue({ binding: { revision: 'test-binding', needsAuthorization: false } })
+  const parts = new Intl.DateTimeFormat('en-CA', {
+    timeZone: 'Asia/Shanghai', year: 'numeric', month: '2-digit', day: '2-digit',
+  }).formatToParts(new Date())
+  const part = (type: Intl.DateTimeFormatPartTypes) => parts.find(item => item.type === type)?.value ?? ''
+  const date = `${part('year')}-${part('month')}-${part('day')}`
+  const events = [
+    { name: '课程 A', campus: '四平路校区', room: '北115', day: 1, start: 1, end: 2, weeks: [1], teacher: '', credits: '' },
+    { name: '课程 B', campus: '四平路校区', room: '南203', day: 1, start: 3, end: 4, weeks: [1], teacher: '', credits: '' },
+  ]
+  api.dataset.mockImplementation(async (key: string) => ({
+    key, status: 'ready', metrics: [], events: key === 'today' ? events : [],
+    ...(key === 'today' ? { teachingDay: { date } } : {}),
+  }))
+  const current = { campusId: 'siping', featureId: 'current-a' }
+  let finishFirst!: (value: unknown) => void
+  const resolveLocation = vi.fn()
+    .mockImplementationOnce(() => new Promise(resolve => { finishFirst = resolve }))
+    .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ raw: '课程 B 的地点', building: '南楼', room: '203', condition: '', target: { campusId: 'siping', featureId: 'b' } }])
+    .mockResolvedValueOnce([{ raw: '当前课程 A 的地点', building: '北楼', room: '115', condition: '', target: current }])
+  const wrapper = mount(CampusMapMinePanel, {
+    props: { authenticated: true, resolveLocation },
+    global: { plugins: [createI18n({ legacy: false, locale: 'zh', messages: { zh } })] },
+  })
+  await flushPromises()
+  const courses = wrapper.findAll('.atlas-mine__course')
+  await courses[0]!.trigger('click')
+  await courses[1]!.trigger('click')
+  await flushPromises()
+  await courses[0]!.trigger('click')
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(wrapper.emitted('select')?.at(-1)).toEqual([current])
+  finishFirst([{ raw: '过时的课程 A 地点', building: '北楼', room: '115', condition: '', target: { campusId: 'siping', featureId: 'stale-a' } }])
+  await flushPromises()
+  expect(wrapper.emitted('select')?.at(-1)).toEqual([current])
+  expect(wrapper.get('.atlas-location-choices').text()).toContain('当前课程 A 的地点')
+  expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('过时的课程 A 地点')
+  wrapper.unmount()
+})

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import { describe, expect, test } from 'vitest'
+import { defineComponent, h } from 'vue'
+import { ChartTooltipContent, componentToString } from '../src/admin/components/ui/chart'
+import { twemojiVuePlugin } from '../src/runtime/twemoji'
+
+describe('chart crosshair tooltip template', () => {
+  // 模板文本插值被编译为全局 TwemojiText；离屏渲染若丢失应用上下文，悬浮卡片会只剩空的 <twemojitext>。
+  test('renders label, series and value text through the app context', () => {
+    let template: ((data: Record<string, number>, x: number | Date) => string) | undefined
+    mount(defineComponent({
+      setup() {
+        template = componentToString({ visits: { label: '访问' } }, ChartTooltipContent, { labelFormatter: () => 'Oct 8, 2026' })
+        return () => h('div')
+      },
+    }), { global: { plugins: [twemojiVuePlugin] } })
+
+    const card = document.createElement('div')
+    card.innerHTML = template!({ visits: 12 }, new Date('2026-10-08T00:00:00Z'))
+
+    expect(card.querySelector('twemojitext')).toBeNull()
+    expect(card.textContent?.replace(/\s+/g, ' ')).toContain('Oct 8, 2026')
+    expect(card.textContent).toContain('访问')
+    expect(card.textContent).toContain('12')
+  })
+})

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount, type VueWrapper } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import * as api from '../src/runtime/api'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import ContentAppeal from '../src/site/components/ContentAppeal.vue'
+import ManagedContent from '../src/site/components/ManagedContent.vue'
+import ModerationAppealQueue from '../src/site/components/ModerationAppealQueue.vue'
+const wrappers: VueWrapper[] = []
+afterEach(() => { wrappers.splice(0).forEach(w => w.unmount()); vi.restoreAllMocks() })
+const appeal = (id = 1): api.AppealItem => ({ id, kind: 'topic', targetId: 7, revisionId: 70, topicId: 7, postNo: 0, title: 'Candidate', content: 'Rejected revision', images: ['/file/img/a.png'], reason: 'Please reconsider', originalReviewReason: 'Looks like spam', status: 'pending', reviewReason: '', createdAt: '2026-10-10T00:00:00Z', reviewedAt: null })
+const content = (extra: Partial<api.MyContentItem> = {}) => ({ id: 7, contentType: 'topic', revisionId: 70, processStatus: 1, hasPublishedVersion: false, reviewReason: 'Looks like spam', title: 'Public title', content: 'Candidate', images: [], createdAt: '', canAppeal: true, appeal: null, ...extra }) as api.MyContentItem
+function mountAuthor(item = content(), open = true) { const w = mount(ContentAppeal, { props: { item, open }, global: { plugins: [i18n] } }); wrappers.push(w); return w }
+function mountQueue() { const w = mount(ModerationAppealQueue, { global: { plugins: [i18n] }, attachTo: document.body }); wrappers.push(w); return w }
+const en = () => { i18n.global.locale.value = 'en' }
+
+test('author submits the latest rejected revision and immediately sees it under review', async () => {
+  en()
+  const submit = vi.spyOn(api, 'submitContentAppeal').mockResolvedValue(true)
+  const w = mountAuthor()
+  expect(w.get('[data-test="appeal-form"]').text()).toContain('Each version can be appealed once.')
+  await w.find('textarea').setValue('  Please reconsider  ')
+  expect(w.text()).toContain('21/512')
+  await w.find('form').trigger('submit'); await flushPromises()
+  expect(submit).toHaveBeenCalledWith('topic', 7, 70, 'Please reconsider')
+  expect(w.emitted('update:open')?.at(-1)).toEqual([false])
+  expect(w.emitted('saved')).toHaveLength(1)
+  expect(w.get('[data-test="appeal-state"]').text()).toContain('Appeal under review')
+  expect(w.get('[role="status"]').text()).toBe('Appeal submitted. We’ll notify you of the decision.')
+})
+
+test('network failure keeps the reason and explains how to recover; server failures show their reason', async () => {
+  en()
+  const submit = vi.spyOn(api, 'submitContentAppeal').mockRejectedValueOnce(new TypeError('Failed to fetch'))

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, describe, expect, it, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import UserAvatar from '../src/site/components/UserAvatar.vue'
+import DecorationEditor from '../src/site/components/DecorationEditor.vue'
+import { equipDecorations, getDecorations } from '../src/runtime/api'
+import type { DecorationState, DecorationStyle } from '@gooseforum/client'
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/api', () => ({ getDecorations: vi.fn(), equipDecorations: vi.fn() }))
+vi.mock('vue-i18n', () => ({ useI18n: () => ({ t: (key: string) => key }) }))
+const frame: DecorationStyle = { code: 'frame-owned', name: 'Owned frame', kind: 'avatarFrame', lightColors: ['#166534'], darkColors: ['#86efac'], isEnabled: true, sortOrder: 1 }
+const state: DecorationState = { catalog: [frame, { ...frame, code: 'frame-locked', name: 'Locked frame' }, { ...frame, code: 'frame-disabled', name: 'Disabled frame', isEnabled: false }], ownedCodes: ['frame-owned', 'frame-disabled'], equipped: { avatarFrame: '', nicknameStyle: '' } }
+afterEach(() => vi.clearAllMocks())
+describe('decoration equipment', () => {
+  it('shows preview but locks unowned and disabled definitions; saves both selected slots', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getDecorations).mockResolvedValue(structuredClone(state))
+    vi.mocked(equipDecorations).mockResolvedValue({ ...state, equipped: { avatarFrame: 'frame-owned', nicknameStyle: '' } })
+    const wrapper = mount(DecorationEditor, { props: { avatarUrl: '/avatar.webp', name: 'Member' }, global: { stubs: { UserAvatar: true, UserNickname: true } } })
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(wrapper.get('input[value="frame-locked"]').attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+    expect(wrapper.get('input[value="frame-disabled"]').attributes('disabled')).toBeDefined()
+    await wrapper.get('input[value="frame-owned"]').setValue(true)
+    await wrapper.get('button').trigger('click')
+    await flushPromises()
+    expect(equipDecorations).toHaveBeenCalledWith({ avatarFrame: 'frame-owned', nicknameStyle: '' })
+    expect(wrapper.emitted('changed')?.[0]?.[0]).toEqual({ avatarFrame: frame, nicknameStyle: undefined })
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+  it('retains the pending selection and shows inline error when saving fails', async () => {
+    vi.mocked(getDecorations).mockResolvedValue(structuredClone(state))
+    vi.mocked(equipDecorations).mockRejectedValue(new Error('Equipment denied'))
+    const wrapper = mount(DecorationEditor, { props: { avatarUrl: '/avatar.webp', name: 'Member' }, global: { stubs: { UserAvatar: true, UserNickname: true } } })
+    await flushPromises(); await wrapper.get('input[value="frame-owned"]').setValue(true); await wrapper.get('button').trigger('click'); await flushPromises()
+    expect(wrapper.get('[role="alert"]').text()).toBe('Equipment denied')
+    expect((wrapper.get('input[value="frame-owned"]').element as HTMLInputElement).checked).toBe(true)
+    expect(wrapper.emitted('changed')).toBeUndefined()
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('avatar frame layout', () => {
+  it('preserves plain avatar markup and overlays an enabled frame without replacing the image', () => {
+    const plain = mount(UserAvatar, { props: { src: '/avatar.webp', alt: 'Member' }, attrs: { class: 'h-10 w-10 rounded-full' } })
+    expect(plain.element.tagName).toBe('IMG')
+    plain.unmount()
+    const framed = mount(UserAvatar, { props: { src: '/avatar.webp', alt: 'Member', frame }, attrs: { class: 'h-10 w-10 rounded-full' } })
+    expect(framed.get('.gf-avatar-frame').attributes('aria-hidden')).toBe('true')
+    expect(framed.get('img').attributes('src')).toBe('/avatar_medium.webp')
+    expect(framed.get('img').attributes('alt')).toBe('Member')
+    expect(framed.classes()).toContain('h-10')
+    framed.unmount()
+  })
+})
+
+describe('image avatar frame', () => {
+  it('uses only bundled artwork, leaves portrait accessible, and never falls back to a gradient', async () => {
+    const wrapper = mount(UserAvatar, { props: { src: '/avatar.webp', alt: 'Member', frame: { ...frame, assetUrl: '/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png' } }, attrs: { class: 'h-10 w-10 rounded-full' } })
+    const artwork = wrapper.get('.gf-avatar-frame-image')
+    expect(artwork.attributes('alt')).toBe('')
+    expect(artwork.attributes('aria-hidden')).toBe('true')
+    expect(wrapper.get('img[alt="Member"]').attributes('src')).toBe('/avatar_medium.webp')
+    expect(wrapper.find('.gf-avatar-frame').exists()).toBe(false)
+    await artwork.trigger('error')
+    expect(wrapper.find('.gf-avatar-frame-image').exists()).toBe(false)
+    expect(wrapper.find('.gf-avatar-frame').exists()).toBe(false)
+    await wrapper.setProps({ frame: { ...frame, assetUrl: 'https://untrusted.example/frame.png' } })
+    expect(wrapper.find('.gf-avatar-frame-image').exists()).toBe(false)
+    expect(wrapper.find('.gf-avatar-frame').exists()).toBe(true)
+    wrapper.unmount()
+  })
+})
+
+it('scales frame artwork around the avatar center and falls back for invalid scale', async () => {
+  const wrapper = mount(UserAvatar, { props: { src: '/avatar.webp', alt: 'Member', frame: { ...frame, assetUrl: '/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png', assetScale: 1.6 } }, attrs: { class: 'h-10 w-10 rounded-full' } })
+  expect((wrapper.element as HTMLElement).style.getPropertyValue('--avatar-frame-size')).toBe('160%')
+  expect((wrapper.element as HTMLElement).style.getPropertyValue('--avatar-frame-offset')).toBe('-30%')
+  await wrapper.setProps({ frame: { ...frame, assetUrl: '/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png', assetScale: 0.75 } })
+  expect((wrapper.element as HTMLElement).style.getPropertyValue('--avatar-frame-offset')).toBe('12.5%')
+  await wrapper.setProps({ frame: { ...frame, assetUrl: '/static/decorations/tea-garden-v1.png', assetScale: 20 } })
+  expect((wrapper.element as HTMLElement).style.getPropertyValue('--avatar-frame-size')).toBe('125%')
+  wrapper.unmount()
+})

+import { describe, expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { decorationVariables, hasNicknameContrast, isSafeDecorationAssetUrl } from '../src/site/utils/decoration-style'
+import type { DecorationStyle } from '@gooseforum/client'
+const style: DecorationStyle = { code: 'tea', name: 'Tea', kind: 'nicknameStyle', lightColors: ['#166534'], darkColors: ['#86efac'], isEnabled: true, sortOrder: 1 }
+describe('decoration rendering boundary', () => {
+  it('rejects disabled and arbitrary CSS colors while allowing one-color gradients', () => {
+    expect(decorationVariables(style)['--decoration-light']).toBe('linear-gradient(120deg, #166534, #166534)')
+    expect(decorationVariables({ ...style, isEnabled: false })).toEqual({})
+    expect(decorationVariables({ ...style, lightColors: ['url(https://invalid)'] })).toEqual({})
+    expect(decorationVariables({ ...style, darkColors: [] })).toEqual({})
+  })
+  it('keeps names readable against custom backgrounds and across the gradient', () => {
+    expect(hasNicknameContrast(style.lightColors, [255, 255, 255])).toBe(true)
+    expect(hasNicknameContrast(style.darkColors, [17, 24, 39])).toBe(true)
+    expect(hasNicknameContrast(style.lightColors, [22, 101, 52])).toBe(false)
+    expect(hasNicknameContrast(['#000000', '#ffffff'], [255, 255, 255])).toBe(false)
+    expect(hasNicknameContrast(['red'], [255, 255, 255])).toBe(false)
+  })
+})
+
+it('accepts all artwork formats without widening trusted decoration paths', () => {
+  for (const ext of ['png', 'webp', 'gif', 'svg']) expect(isSafeDecorationAssetUrl(`/static/decorations/frame.${ext}`)).toBe(true)
+  for (const url of ['https://example.com/frame.gif', '/static/decorations/../frame.svg', '/static/decorations/frame.gif?x=1', '/static/decorations/frame.html']) expect(isSafeDecorationAssetUrl(url)).toBe(false)
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server
+let browser
+let origin
+
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({
+    root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)),
+    server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false },
+  })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+
+after(async () => {
+  await browser?.close()
+  await server?.close()
+})
+
+const locales = {
+  zh: { cancel: '取消', empty: '还没有草稿' },
+  en: { cancel: 'Cancel', empty: 'No drafts yet' },
+  ja: { cancel: 'キャンセル', empty: '下書きはまだありません' },
+  de: { cancel: 'Abbrechen', empty: 'Noch keine Entwürfe' },
+}
+
+for (const [locale, copy] of Object.entries(locales)) {
+  test(`草稿删除确认可用键盘与触屏并正确更新空状态（${locale}，Chromium）`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({
+      viewport: { width: 360, height: 780 },
+      isMobile: true,
+      hasTouch: true,
+    })
+    page.setDefaultTimeout(8_000)
+    page.setDefaultNavigationTimeout(8_000)
+    let deletionCount = 0
+    let deleteBody
+    try {
+      await page.route('**/api/forum/user/content-event', route => route.fulfill({
+        status: 200,
+        contentType: 'application/json',
+        body: JSON.stringify({ code: 0, result: true }),
+      }))
+      await page.route('**/api/forum/topics/delete', async route => {
+        deletionCount++
+        deleteBody = route.request().postDataJSON()
+        await route.fulfill({
+          status: 200,
+          contentType: 'application/json',
+          body: JSON.stringify({ code: 0, result: true }),
+        })
+      })
+
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/drafts-page.html?lang=${locale}`)
+      const deleteButton = page.getByRole('button', { name: /A saved draft/ })
+      const editLink = page.getByRole('link', { name: /A saved draft/ }).first()
+      await deleteButton.waitFor()
+      await editLink.waitFor()
+      assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth))
+      assert.ok((await deleteButton.boundingBox()).height >= 40)
+
+      await deleteButton.focus()
+      await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
+      const dialog = page.getByRole('alertdialog')
+      await dialog.waitFor()
+      assert.match(await dialog.textContent(), /A saved draft/)
+      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute('data-test')), 'cancel-delete')
+      await page.keyboard.press('Escape')
+      await dialog.waitFor({ state: 'detached' })
+      assert.equal(deletionCount, 0)
+
+      const buttonBox = await deleteButton.boundingBox()
+      await page.touchscreen.tap(buttonBox.x + buttonBox.width / 2, buttonBox.y + buttonBox.height / 2)
+      await dialog.waitFor()
+      await page.locator('[data-test="confirm-delete"]').focus()
+      await page.keyboard.press('Enter')
+      await page.getByText(copy.empty, { exact: true }).waitFor()
+
+      assert.equal(deletionCount, 1)
+      assert.equal(deleteBody.topicId, 42)
+      assert.ok(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth))
+      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.activeElement?.getAttribute('href')), '/publish')
+    } finally {
+      await page.close()
+    }
+  })
+}

@@ -0,0 +1,40 @@
+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { reconcileForYou, refreshForYou } from '../src/runtime/feed-session-api'
+import { feedAccount, resetFeedAccount } from '../src/runtime/feed-telemetry'
+import * as telemetry from '../src/runtime/feed-telemetry'
+
+afterEach(() => { resetFeedAccount(0); vi.restoreAllMocks(); vi.unstubAllGlobals() })
+
+test('account change during pending confirmation cannot refresh the new account', async () => {
+  resetFeedAccount(12)
+  vi.spyOn(telemetry, 'pendingSeenPatches').mockReturnValueOnce(Array.from({ length: 51 }, () => ({ proof: 'pending', seen: { 0: 1000 } })))
+  vi.spyOn(telemetry, 'confirmPendingSeen').mockImplementation(async () => { resetFeedAccount(13) })
+  const fetchMock = vi.fn(async () => ({ status: 200, ok: true,
+    json: async () => ({ code: 0, result: { viewerId: 13, seenConfirmed: true } }) }))
+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)
+  await expect(refreshForYou(undefined, 'account-12-session')).rejects.toThrow()
+  expect(fetchMock).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  expect(feedAccount()).toBe(13)
+})
+
+test('refresh identifies the current snapshot without replacing another history session', async () => {
+  resetFeedAccount(12)
+  const fetchMock = vi.fn(async (_url: string, _options: RequestInit) => ({ status: 200, ok: true,
+    json: async () => ({ code: 0, result: { viewerId: 12, seenConfirmed: true } }) }))
+  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', fetchMock)
+  await refreshForYou(undefined, 'newer-session')
+  expect(JSON.parse(String(fetchMock.mock.calls[0][1].body))).toMatchObject({ replaceSnapshotId: 'newer-session', seenPatches: [] })
+})
+for (const status of [200, 401]) {
+  test(`a late ${status} response cannot restore or log out a changed account`, async () => {
+    resetFeedAccount(12)
+    let resolve!: (value: unknown) => void
+    vi.stubGlobal('fetch', vi.fn(() => new Promise((r) => { resolve = r })))
+    const result = reconcileForYou([31])
+    resetFeedAccount(13)
+    resolve({ status, ok: status === 200, json: async () => ({ code: 0, result: { viewerId: 12 } }) })
+    await expect(result).rejects.toThrow()
+    expect(feedAccount()).toBe(13)
+  })
+}

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/feed-switch.browser.mjs b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/feed-switch.browser.mjs
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..57c37e638
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/feed-switch.browser.mjs
@@ -0,0 +1,52 @@
+// issue #1164：列表/卡片切换必须复用已挂载的行节点，而不是整表卸载重建。
+// happy-dom 的组件测试锁行为契约；这里在真实浏览器里确认 v-show 切换与隐藏树的属性裁剪。
+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+test('切换列表/卡片复用行节点，隐藏树不携带 data-feed-id', async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 1440, height: 900 } })
+  try {
+    await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/feed-switch.html?count=8`)
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.documentElement.dataset.ready === 'true')
+    // 空闲预建完成后两棵树都在，但只有列表可见
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => document.querySelector('[data-feed-view="card"]'))
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-view="card"]').evaluate((el) => getComputedStyle(el).display), 'none')
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 8)
+
+    await page.evaluate(() => { window.__rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-feed-view="table"] .gf-topic-row')] })
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '卡片' }).click()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-feed-view="card"]')).display !== 'none')
+
+    const reused = await page.evaluate(() => {
+      const rows = [...document.querySelectorAll('[data-feed-view="table"] .gf-topic-row')]
+      return rows.length === window.__rows.length && rows.every((row, index) => row === window.__rows[index]) && rows.every((row) => row.isConnected)
+    })
+    assert.ok(reused, 'switching must reuse the mounted table rows instead of rebuilding them')
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-view="table"] .gf-topic-row [data-feed-id]').count(), 0)
+
+    // 传导与推荐流锚点按文档顺序查询 [data-feed-id]：命中必须全部是可见卡片树里的行
+    const tagged = await page.$$eval('[data-feed-id]', (rows) => rows.map((row) => Boolean(row.closest('[data-feed-view="card"]'))))
+    assert.deepEqual(tagged, Array(8).fill(true))
+
+    await page.getByRole('button', { name: '列表' }).click()
+    await page.waitForFunction(() => getComputedStyle(document.querySelector('[data-feed-view="table"]')).display !== 'none')
+    const cards = await page.$$eval('[data-feed-view="card"] .gf-card', (els) => els.length)
+    assert.equal(cards, 8)
+    assert.equal(await page.$$eval('[data-feed-view="card"] [data-feed-id]', (els) => els.length), 0)
+    assert.equal(await page.locator('[data-feed-id]').count(), 8)
+  } finally {
+    await page.close()
+  }
+})

+import { createBrowserApp as createApp } from './create-app'

+  AdminAnonymousIdentity,
+  FeedSummary,
+} from '../../../src/admin/runtime/api'
+import '../../../src/admin/styles/admin.css'
+
+// Synthetic data renders production components/CSS, with no real private mappings.
+const params = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
+await setLocale((params.get('lang') || 'zh') as 'zh' | 'en' | 'ja' | 'de')
+if (params.get('theme') === 'dark')

+layout.viewer = {

+  username: 'demo_admin',

+  canAccessAdmin: true,
+  adminPermissions: [0, 7],
+}
+layout.site.name = 'YourTJ Forum'

+configureAdminAccess([0, 7])
+const names = [
+  '躲进云里的猫',

+  '趴在书桌的狐',

+const identities: AdminAnonymousIdentity[] = Array.from(

+    name: names[index % names.length]!,

+)
+const summary: FeedSummary = {
+  enabled: true,
+  rankingReady: true,
+  metricsEnabled: true,
+  rolloutPercent: 20,
+  rawRetentionDays: 30,
+  paramsHash: '7c918b2d3ad9f642',

+        RecencyHalfLifeHours: 12,
+      },
+    },
+  },
+  rows: ['served', 'visible', 'open', 'read', 'like', 'reply'].map(
+    (metric, index) => ({
+      day: '2026-10-07',
+      feed: index < 4 ? 'for_you' : 'daily',
+      hash: '7c918b2d3ad9f642',
+      rankHash: '48abc192',
+      experiment: 'autumn-2026',
+      variant: index % 2 ? 'treatment' : 'control',
+      weightVariant: 'base',
+      capability: 'web-v1',
+      metric,
+      count: [6840, 4210, 1628, 1245, 386, 129][index]!,
+    }),
+  ),
+  periods: [
+    {
+      id: 'autumn-2026',
+      hash: '7c918b2d3ad9f642',
+      enrollUntil: '2026-10-14T08:00:00Z',
+      analyzeAt: '2026-10-22T08:00:00Z',
+      aborted: '',
+      assignedControl: 820,
+      assignedTreatment: 816,
+      result: '',
+    },
+  ],
+}
+const originalFetch = window.fetch.bind(window)
+window.fetch = async (input, init) => {
+  const url =
+    typeof input === 'string'
+      ? input
+      : input instanceof URL
+        ? input.href
+        : input.url
+  const body = typeof init?.body === 'string' ? JSON.parse(init.body) : {}
+  const json = (result: unknown) =>
+    new Response(JSON.stringify({ code: 0, result }), {
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    })
+  if (url.endsWith('/anonymous-identities/list')) {
+    const matches = identities.filter(
+      (row) =>
+        (!body.search ||
+          `${row.name} ${row.publicUid} ${row.owner.username} ${row.owner.userId}`.includes(
+            body.search,
+          )) &&
+        (body.status === 'all' ||
+          body.status ===
+            (row.governanceDisabled
+              ? 'banned'
+              : row.disabled
+                ? 'disabled'
+                : 'active')),
+    )
+    return json({
+      items: matches.slice(
+        (body.page - 1) * body.pageSize,
+        body.page * body.pageSize,
+      ),
+      total: matches.length,
+      page: body.page,
+      pageSize: body.pageSize,
+    })
+  }
+  if (url.endsWith('/anonymous-identities/govern')) {
+    identities.find(
+      (row) => row.publicUid === body.publicUid,
+    )!.governanceDisabled = body.disabled
+    return json(true)
+  }
+  if (url.endsWith('/feed/summary')) return json(summary)
+  if (url.endsWith('/get-site-statistics'))
+    return json({
+      userCount: 1641,
+      userMonthCount: 109,
+      topicMaxId: 483,
+      topicMonthCount: 79,
+      postMaxId: 2104,
+      linksCount: 6,
+    })
+  if (url.endsWith('/traffic-overview'))
+    return json(

+        regCount: 6 + i,
+        topicCount: 12 + i,
+        replyCount: 38 + i * 3,
+        courseReviewCount: i,
+      })),
+    )
+  if (url.endsWith('/server-version'))
+    return json({
+      version: 'v0.0.50',
+      commit: 'demo',
+      buildDate: '2026-10-07',
+      mode: 'development',
+    })
+  if (url.includes('api.github.com'))
+    return new Response('[]', {
+      headers: { 'Content-Type': 'application/json' },
+    })
+  return originalFetch(input, init)
+}
+const router = createRouter({
+  history: createMemoryHistory(),
+  routes: [
+    { path: '/admin/anonymous-identities', component: AnonymousManagementPage },
+    { path: '/admin/feed-statistics', component: FeedStatisticsPage },
+    { path: '/admin', component: StatsPage },
+  ],
+})
+await router.push(
+  params.get('page') === 'feed'
+    ? '/admin/feed-statistics'
+    : params.get('page') === 'home'
+      ? '/admin'
+      : '/admin/anonymous-identities',
+)
+createApp(AdminApp, {
+  payload: {
+    component: 'manage-home',
+    props: {},
+    layout,
+    meta: { title: 'Admin preview' },
+    url: router.currentRoute.value.path,
+    version: 'test',
+  },
+})
+  .use(i18n)
+  .use(router)
+  .mount('#app')
+document.documentElement.dataset.ready = 'true'

diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/feed-switch.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/feed-switch.ts

index 000000000..e5c52e4e8
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/feed-switch.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,59 @@
+// issue #1164：首页「列表 / 卡片」视图切换的 INP 基线夹具。
+// 渲染真实 HomePage（latest 排序，20 条话题，含图文卡片），供 feed-switch.browser.mjs
+// 量测切换时的处理耗时与 DOM 复用情况。
+import { defineComponent, h, KeepAlive, shallowRef } from 'vue'
+import HomePage from '../../../src/site/pages/HomePage.vue'
+import { installNavigation, type PreparedPage } from '../../../src/runtime/router'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../../../src/runtime/i18n'
+import type { HomeProps, LayoutPayload, TopicPayload } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import { createBrowserApp } from './create-app'
+import '../../../src/styles/resource.css'
+
+await setLocale('zh')
+document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'gf-light'
+const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
+const count = Number(query.get('count') ?? 20)
+
+const art = '/assets/test/fixtures/browser/topic-feed-art.svg'
+const withImages = query.get('images') !== '0'
+const seed = (id: number): TopicPayload => ({
+  id,
+  title: `话题标题 ${id}：关于校园生活的一些讨论`,
+  description: '这是一段描述文本，用于模拟真实话题的摘要内容，帮助读者判断是否要打开这篇帖子。'.repeat(2),
+  url: `/p/post/${id}`,
+  author: { id: 1000 + id, username: `作者 ${id}`, avatarUrl: art },
+  participants: [
+    { id: 1000 + id, username: `作者 ${id}`, avatarUrl: art },
+    { id: 2000 + id, username: `回复者 ${id}`, avatarUrl: art },
+  ],
+  categories: [{ id: 7, name: '校园生活', url: '/c/7', color: '#3b82f6' }],
+  replyCount: 12, likeCount: 5, viewCount: 640,
+  activityText: '刚刚', lastUpdateTime: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
+  pinWeight: 0, processStatus: 0, contentType: 0, liked: false, bookmarked: false,
+  images: !withImages ? [] : id % 3 === 0 ? [art, art, art] : id % 3 === 1 ? [art] : [],
+  feedTrace: 'trace-fixture', feedPosition: id - 1,
+})
+
+const props: HomeProps = {
+  sort: 'latest',
+  tabs: [{ key: 'latest', active: true, url: '/?sort=latest' }, { key: 'hot', active: false, url: '/?sort=hot' }],
+  topics: Array.from({ length: count }, (_, i) => seed(i + 1)),
+  pagination: { page: 1, nextPage: 2, hasNext: false, nextUrl: '' },
+  announcement: { enabled: false, html: '', items: [] },
+}
+const layout = { viewer: { id: 12, isAuthenticated: true, requiresEmailVerification: false } } as LayoutPayload
+const initial: PreparedPage = { component: HomePage, payload: { component: 'home.index', props, layout, url: '/?sort=latest', version: '1.0' } }
+const current = shallowRef(initial)
+window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/?sort=latest')
+const root = defineComponent({ setup: () => () => h('main', [
+  h(KeepAlive, {}, () => current.value.payload.component === 'home.index'
+    ? h(HomePage, { key: 'home.index', props: current.value.payload.props as HomeProps, layout, pageUrl: current.value.payload.url }) : null),
+]) })
+const router = installNavigation(initial, root, (page) => { current.value = page })
+const app = createBrowserApp(root).use(i18n).use(router)
+await router.isReady()
+performance.mark('feed-mount-start')
+app.mount('#app')
+performance.mark('feed-mount-end')
+performance.measure('feed-mount', 'feed-mount-start', 'feed-mount-end')
+document.documentElement.dataset.ready = 'true'

+import { defineComponent, h, KeepAlive, shallowRef } from 'vue'
+import { createBrowserApp as createApp } from './create-app'
+import HomePage from '../../../src/site/pages/HomePage.vue'
+import { installNavigation, type PreparedPage } from '../../../src/runtime/router'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../../../src/runtime/i18n'
+import type { HomeProps, LayoutPayload, TopicPayload } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import '../../../src/styles/resource.css'
+
+await setLocale('zh')
+document.documentElement.dataset.theme = 'gf-light'
+const query = new URLSearchParams(location.search)
+const empty = query.get('empty') === '1'
+const seed = (id: number): TopicPayload => ({ id, title: `推荐帖子 ${id}`, description: '校园里的新讨论，读者可以继续原来的浏览位置。'.repeat(3),
+  url: `/p/post/${id}`, author: { id: 1000 + id, username: `作者 ${id}`, avatarUrl: '/assets/test/fixtures/browser/topic-feed-art.svg' }, participants: [], categories: [],
+  replyCount: 3, likeCount: 0, viewCount: 12, activityText: '刚刚', lastUpdateTime: '2026-10-07T00:00:00Z',
+  pinWeight: 0, processStatus: 0, contentType: 0, liked: false, bookmarked: false, feedTrace: 'trace-original', feedPosition: (id - 1) % 20 })
+const props: HomeProps = { sort: 'for_you', actualSort: 'for_you', snapshotId: 'original',
+  tabs: [{ key: 'for_you', active: true, url: '/?sort=for_you' }, { key: 'latest', active: false, url: '/?sort=latest' }],
+  topics: empty ? [] : Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => seed(i + 1)),
+  seenProofs: empty ? [] : [{ token: 'proof-1', topicIds: Array.from({ length: 20 }, (_, i) => i + 1), issuedAt: Date.now(), expiresAt: Date.now() + 1_800_000 }],
+  pagination: { page: 1, nextPage: 2, hasNext: !empty, nextUrl: empty ? '' : '/?sort=for_you&cursor=next-20' },
+  announcement: { enabled: false, html: '', items: [] } }
+const layout = { viewer: { id: 12, isAuthenticated: true, requiresEmailVerification: false } } as LayoutPayload
+const initial: PreparedPage = { component: HomePage, payload: { component: 'home.index', props, layout, url: '/?sort=for_you', version: '1.0' } }
+const current = shallowRef(initial)
+window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/?sort=for_you')
+const root = defineComponent({ setup: () => () => h('main', [
+  h(KeepAlive, {}, () => current.value.payload.component === 'home.index'
+    ? h(HomePage, { key: 'home.index', props: current.value.payload.props as HomeProps, layout, pageUrl: current.value.payload.url }) : null),
+  current.value.payload.component === 'topic.detail' ? h('section', { 'data-testid': 'detail', style: 'height:1200px' }, [
+    h('h1', '详情'), ...['like', 'bookmark', 'comment'].map((action) => h('button', {
+      'data-action': action, onClick: () => fetch(`/api/forum/test-${action}`, { method: 'POST' }),
+    }, action)),
+  ]) : null,
+]) })
+const router = installNavigation(initial, root, (page) => { current.value = page })
+const app = createApp(root).use(i18n).use(router)
+await router.isReady()
+app.mount('#app')
+document.documentElement.dataset.ready = 'true'

+}

+  tabs: ['profile', 'account', 'privacy', 'notifications', 'binding', 'security', 'content', 'deleted', 'general']
+    .map(key => ({ key, url: `/settings?tab=${key}`, active: key === 'privacy' })),
+}
+

evidence.title: apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/topic-badges.ts
evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/topic-badges.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/topic-badges.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..9e36f1cbc
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/fixtures/browser/topic-badges.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,66 @@
+// issue #1063：信息流内容类型徽章（提问/瞬间/文章）在长标题、窄内容列下被挤压折行。
+// 这里铺「宽屏内容列（约 634px）/ 窄屏满宽」两组、每组各含无压力基准行与长标题行，另加一张卡片，
+// 供 topic-badges.browser.mjs 量测徽章几何。
+import { h } from 'vue'
+import { createBrowserApp as createApp } from './create-app'
+import TopicList from '../../../src/site/components/TopicList.vue'
+import TopicRow from '../../../src/site/components/TopicRow.vue'
+import { i18n, setLocale } from '../../../src/runtime/i18n'
+import '../../../src/styles/resource.css'
+import type { TopicPayload } from '@gooseforum/client'
+
+// ?locale=<code> 让同一个 fixture 覆盖 en/de/ja 的长标签（Question/Artikel/モーメント…）。
+await setLocale(new URLSearchParams(window.location.search).get('locale') ?? 'zh')
+
+// 长标题吃满内容列，与 issue 截图中的「TJ Class Schedule 更新！妈妈再也不用担心我忘记提交作业了……」同类。
+const LONG_TITLE = 'TJ Class Schedule 更新！妈妈再也不用担心我忘记提交作业了——课表同步、教室变更与考试周提醒全都帮你记着，标题再长也要完整阅读'
+const SHORT_TITLE = '短标题'
+
+// 列表行在 lg 断点走 5 列网格：内容列 minmax(0,1fr) + 112/72/72/88 + gap/px。
+// 容器 1040px 时内容列约 634px，与 issue 报告的「宽屏侧栏占位后约 634px」一致。
+const LG_ROW_WIDTH = 1040
+
+function topic(contentType: 0 | 1 | 2 | 3, id: number, title: string): TopicPayload {
+  return {
+    id,
+    title,
+    description: '内容描述',
+    url: `/p/${id}`,
+    author: { id: 1, username: 'tester', nickname: '测试者', avatarUrl: '' },
+    participants: [{ id: 1, username: 'tester', nickname: '测试者', avatarUrl: '' }],
+    categories: [{ id: 7, name: '校园生活', url: '/c/7', color: '#3b82f6' }],
+    replyCount: 12,
+    viewCount: 640,
+    pinWeight: 0,
+    processStatus: 0,
+    activityText: '刚刚',
+    lastUpdateTime: '2026-10-05T00:00:00Z',
+    contentType,
+  }
+}
+
+const listRows = ([1, 2, 3] as const).flatMap((type, index) => [
+  // 自然宽度基准：短标题无收缩压力，徽章保持完整尺寸。
+  h('div', { 'data-case': `natural-${type}`, style: `width:${LG_ROW_WIDTH}px` }, [
+    h(TopicRow, { topic: topic(type, index * 10 + 1, SHORT_TITLE), home: true }),
+  ]),
+  h('div', { 'data-case': `narrow-lg-${type}`, style: `width:${LG_ROW_WIDTH}px` }, [
+    h(TopicRow, { topic: topic(type, index * 10 + 2, LONG_TITLE), home: true }),
+  ]),
+  // 窄屏行跟随视口宽度（width:100%），测试用不同 viewport 反复量测。
+  h('div', { 'data-case': `natural-sm-${type}`, style: 'width:100%' }, [
+    h(TopicRow, { topic: topic(type, index * 10 + 3, SHORT_TITLE), home: true }),
+  ]),
+  h('div', { 'data-case': `narrow-sm-${type}`, style: 'width:100%' }, [
+    h(TopicRow, { topic: topic(type, index * 10 + 4, LONG_TITLE), home: true }),
+  ]),
+])
+
+createApp({
+  render: () => h('div', { class: 'flex flex-col gap-4 p-4' }, [
+    ...listRows,
+    h('div', { 'data-case': 'card', style: 'width:320px' }, [
+      h(TopicList, { topics: [topic(3, 99, LONG_TITLE)], viewerId: 1, feedMode: 'card' }),
+    ]),
+  ]),
+}).use(i18n).mount('#app')

+  await page.addInitScript(() => {
+    class Events {
+      static instances = []
+      constructor() { this.handlers = {}; Events.instances.push(this) }

+      close() {}
+    }

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import type { HomeProps, PagePayload } from '@gooseforum/client'
+import { activeForYouSession, historySessionKey, restoreForYouSession, saveForYouSession, setSessionOwner, updateForYouSession, lostForYouPage } from '../src/runtime/for-you-sessions'
+
+function page(ids = [1, 2]) {
+  return { component: {}, payload: { component: 'home.index', url: '/?sort=for_you',
+    props: { sort: 'for_you', snapshotId: 'snapshot', topics: ids.map((id) => ({ id })),
+      pagination: { page: 2, nextPage: 3, hasNext: true, nextUrl: '/?sort=for_you&cursor=old' } } } as unknown as PagePayload }
+}
+afterEach(() => { setSessionOwner(0); vi.useRealTimers() })
+test('history entries with identical URLs retain separate loaded batches and cursors', () => {
+  setSessionOwner(12)
+  const first = historySessionKey(1), second = historySessionKey(3)
+  saveForYouSession(first, page())
+  activeForYouSession.value = first
+  updateForYouSession({ ...page().payload.props, topics: [{ id: 2 }, { id: 1 }, { id: 3 }] } as HomeProps)
+  saveForYouSession(second, page([4, 5]))
+  expect((restoreForYouSession(first)!.payload.props as HomeProps).topics.map((t) => t.id)).toEqual([2, 1, 3])
+  expect((restoreForYouSession(second)!.payload.props as HomeProps).topics.map((t) => t.id)).toEqual([4, 5])
+  expect((restoreForYouSession(first)!.payload.props as HomeProps).pagination.nextUrl).toContain('cursor=old')
+})
+test('cache is bounded to two sessions, expires when inactive and clears on account change', () => {
+  vi.useFakeTimers(); setSessionOwner(12)
+  for (let i = 1; i <= 3; i++) { vi.advanceTimersByTime(1); saveForYouSession(historySessionKey(i), page([i])) }
+  expect(restoreForYouSession(historySessionKey(1))).toBeUndefined()
+  expect((lostForYouPage('/?sort=for_you')!.payload.props as HomeProps).sessionLost).toBe(true)
+  vi.advanceTimersByTime(30 * 60 * 1000)
+  expect(restoreForYouSession(historySessionKey(3))).toBeUndefined()
+  setSessionOwner(13)
+  expect(lostForYouPage('/?sort=for_you')).toBeUndefined()
+  expect(activeForYouSession.value).toBe('')
+})
+test('oversized payload is discarded rather than stored without a budget', () => {
+  setSessionOwner(12)
+  const large = page(); (large.payload.props as HomeProps).topics[0]!.description = 'x'.repeat(513 * 1024)
+  saveForYouSession(historySessionKey(1), large)
+  expect(restoreForYouSession(historySessionKey(1))).toBeUndefined()
+})
+
+test('the combined byte budget evicts an older session when two individual pages fit', () => {
+  setSessionOwner(12)
+  const large = page(); (large.payload.props as HomeProps).topics[0]!.description = 'x'.repeat(300 * 1024)
+  saveForYouSession(historySessionKey(1), large)
+  saveForYouSession(historySessionKey(2), large)
+  expect(restoreForYouSession(historySessionKey(1))).toBeUndefined()
+  expect(restoreForYouSession(historySessionKey(2))).toBeDefined()
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'

+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+// 量公告面板的真实几何：面板高度、面板下方第一个兄弟元素的顶边、
+// 各公告层的左上角（同格叠放判据）与当前可见层。
+// 面板高度稳定 = 下方话题列表不随轮播上下移动（issue #1102）。
+function readGeometry(page) {
+  return page.evaluate(() => {
+    const panel = document.querySelector('.gf-announcement-panel')
+    const below = panel.nextElementSibling
+    const layers = [...panel.querySelectorAll('[data-testid="announcement-item"]')]
+    const visible = layers.filter((el) => !el.classList.contains('invisible'))
+    return {
+      panelHeight: panel.getBoundingClientRect().height,
+      belowTop: below.getBoundingClientRect().top,
+      layerCount: layers.length,
+      visibleCount: visible.length,
+      layerRects: layers.map((el) => {
+        const rect = el.getBoundingClientRect()
+        return { top: rect.top, left: rect.left }
+      }),
+      visibleText: visible.map((el) => el.textContent.replace(/\s+/g, '')).join(''),
+    }
+  })
+}
+
+test('公告轮播与圆点切换时面板高度稳定，下方内容不移动（issue #1102）', async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 880, height: 900 } })
+  try {
+    await page.emulateMedia({ reducedMotion: 'no-preference' })
+    await page.route('**/api/forum/events', (route) => route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/event-stream', body: '' }))
+    // 假时钟：同一套定时器逻辑下把 6 秒自动轮播推进到触发点，不真等。
+    await page.clock.install()
+    await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/home-announcement-rotation.html`)
+    await page.locator('.gf-announcement-panel').waitFor()
+
+    const initial = await readGeometry(page)
+    assert.equal(initial.layerCount, 3, '所有公告条目都应参与高度预留（同格叠放）')
+    assert.equal(initial.visibleCount, 1, '同一时刻只应展示一条公告')
+    assert.ok(initial.visibleText.includes('一行短公告'), `初始应展示第一条公告，实际：${initial.visibleText}`)
+
+    // 同格叠放：所有条目层共享同一网格单元，行高才由最高条目决定
+    const [firstLayer, ...otherLayers] = initial.layerRects
+    for (const rect of otherLayers) {
+      assert.equal(rect.top, firstLayer.top, '所有条目层必须叠放在同一网格单元（top）')
+      assert.equal(rect.left, firstLayer.left, '所有条目层必须叠放在同一网格单元（left）')
+    }
+
+    // 非激活条目必须排除在无障碍树与 Tab 焦点序之外（对齐折叠态 v-if 先例）
+    assert.equal(await page.getByRole('link', { name: '说明链接' }).count(), 0, '隐藏公告内的链接不得进入无障碍树')
+    assert.equal(
+      await page.evaluate(() => {
+        const link = document.querySelector('[data-testid="announcement-item"][inert] a')
+        link.focus()
+        return document.activeElement === link
+      }),
+      false,
+      '隐藏公告内的链接不得可获得焦点',
+    )
+
+    // 自动轮播（6000ms）切到多行的第二条
+    await page.clock.runFor(6200)
+    const afterAuto = await readGeometry(page)
+    assert.equal(afterAuto.visibleCount, 1)
+    assert.ok(afterAuto.visibleText.includes('第二条公告的第一段说明文字。'), `自动轮播后应展示第二条公告，实际：${afterAuto.visibleText}`)
+    assert.equal(afterAuto.panelHeight, initial.panelHeight, '自动轮播后面板高度必须不变')
+    assert.equal(afterAuto.belowTop, initial.belowTop, '自动轮播后下方内容不得移动')
+
+    // 手动圆点切换：多行 → 两行、两行 → 一行，高度与下方位置同样不变
+    await page.getByRole('tab').nth(2).click()
+    const afterManual = await readGeometry(page)
+    assert.ok(afterManual.visibleText.includes('中等公告第一行'), `圆点切换后应展示第三条公告，实际：${afterManual.visibleText}`)
+    assert.equal(afterManual.panelHeight, initial.panelHeight, '圆点切换后面板高度必须不变')
+    assert.equal(afterManual.belowTop, initial.belowTop, '圆点切换后下方内容不得移动')
+
+    await page.getByRole('tab').nth(1).click()
+    const afterBack = await readGeometry(page)
+    assert.ok(afterBack.visibleText.includes('第二条公告的第一段说明文字。'))
+    assert.equal(afterBack.panelHeight, initial.panelHeight)
+    assert.equal(afterBack.belowTop, initial.belowTop)
+
+    // 该条目此时可见：链接回到无障碍树
+    assert.equal(await page.getByRole('link', { name: '说明链接' }).count(), 1)
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})
+
+// reduced-motion 下不启动自动轮播，但圆点手动切换仍会换条目；
+// 固定高度方案不含动效，这批用户同样不受整页跳动影响（issue #1102）。
+test('prefers-reduced-motion 下圆点切换同样不改变面板高度（issue #1102）', async () => {
+  const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width: 880, height: 900 }, reducedMotion: 'reduce' })
+  try {
+    await page.route('**/api/forum/events', (route) => route.fulfill({ status: 200, contentType: 'text/event-stream', body: '' }))
+    await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/home-announcement-rotation.html`)
+    await page.locator('.gf-announcement-panel').waitFor()
+
+    const initial = await readGeometry(page)
+    assert.equal(initial.visibleCount, 1)
+    assert.ok(initial.visibleText.includes('一行短公告'), `初始应展示第一条公告，实际：${initial.visibleText}`)
+
+    await page.getByRole('tab').nth(1).click()
+    const after = await readGeometry(page)
+    assert.ok(after.visibleText.includes('第二条公告的第一段说明文字。'), `圆点切换后应展示第二条公告，实际：${after.visibleText}`)
+    assert.equal(after.panelHeight, initial.panelHeight, 'reduced-motion 下圆点切换面板高度必须不变')
+    assert.equal(after.belowTop, initial.belowTop, 'reduced-motion 下下方内容不得移动')
+  } finally { await page.close() }
+})

evidence.detail:
diff --git a/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/location-dictionary.test.ts b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/location-dictionary.test.ts
new file mode 100644
index 000000000..b5bf972ae
--- /dev/null
+++ b/apps/gooseforum/resource/test/location-dictionary.test.ts
@@ -0,0 +1,72 @@
+import { mkdtemp, readFile, rm, writeFile } from 'node:fs/promises'
+import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
+import { join } from 'node:path'
+import { expect, it } from 'vitest'
+import { assembleDictionary, checkAssets, mergeDictionaries, prepareRequests, validateDictionary, validateResult } from '../scripts/campus-locations/dictionary.mjs'
+import table from '../src/site/campus-map/data/locations/2026-2027-1.json'
+import schema from '../scripts/campus-locations/result.schema.json'
+import type { ExtractedLocation, LocationExtraction, LocationKind, LocationRelation } from '../src/site/campus-map/location-types'
+
+const member: ExtractedLocation = { source_text: '示例楼101', kind: 'named', place: '示例楼', detail: '101', campus_text: null, address: null, conditions: [], time: null }
+const result: LocationExtraction = { relation: 'single', locations: [member], unassigned_conditions: [], needs_review: false, review_reasons: [] }
+
+it('validates the complete published candidate and all v2 prompt examples', async () => {
+  expect(await checkAssets()).toEqual({ inputs: 702, members: 779, flagged: 89, reviewStatus: 'review_2_pending', fewShotPairs: 12 })
+  expect(schema.required.sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(result).sort())
+  expect(schema.properties.locations.items.required.sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(member).sort())
+  const kinds: Record<LocationKind, true> = { named: true, generic: true, online: true, pending: true, no_room: true, unknown: true }
+  const relations: Record<LocationRelation, true> = { single: true, list: true, conditional: true, alternative: true, mixed: true, unclear: true }
+  expect(schema.properties.locations.items.properties.kind.enum.sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(kinds).sort())
+  expect(schema.properties.relation.enum.sort()).toEqual(Object.keys(relations).sort())
+})
+
+it('rejects schema drift, source rewrites and untraceable time conditions', () => {
+  for (const change of [
+    { ...member, time: [] }, { ...member, time: ['单周'] }, { ...member, source_text: '别的楼' },
+    { ...member, kind: 'online' }, { ...member, target: 'invented' }, { ...member, kind: 'building' },
+  ]) expect(() => validateResult({ ...result, locations: [change] }, member.source_text)).toThrow()
+  const missing = structuredClone(result) as unknown as { locations: Record<string, unknown>[] }
+  delete missing.locations[0]!.time
+  expect(() => validateResult(missing, member.source_text)).toThrow()
+  expect(() => validateDictionary({ ...table, _meta: { ...table._meta, input_count: 701 } })).toThrow(/input_count/)
+})
+
+it('merges only new same-term entries and never overwrites reviewed values or promotes status', () => {
+  const candidate = { _meta: { ...table._meta, input_count: 1 }, dictionary: { '四平路校区': { [member.source_text]: result } } }
+  const merged = mergeDictionaries({ ...table, _meta: { ...table._meta, review_status: 'reviewed' } }, candidate)
+  expect(merged.dictionary['四平路校区']['北115']).toEqual(table.dictionary['四平路校区']['北115'])
+  expect(merged._meta.review_status).toBe('review_2_pending')
+  expect(merged._meta.input_count).toBe(703)
+  expect(validateDictionary(table).inputs).toBe(702)
+  expect(() => mergeDictionaries(table, { ...candidate, _meta: { ...candidate._meta, calendar_id: 123 } })).toThrow(/calendar_id/)
+  const changed = structuredClone(table)
+  changed.dictionary['四平路校区']['北115'].locations[0]!.detail = '999'
+  expect(() => mergeDictionaries(table, changed)).toThrow(/Conflicting/)
+})
+
+it('prepares bounded, deduplicated offline prompts without overwriting inputs or including extra fields', async () => {
+  const directory = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'yourtj-location-request-'))
+  try {
+    const input = join(directory, 'input.json'), output = join(directory, 'requests')
+    const entries = Array.from({ length: 21 }, (_, index) => ({ course_campus: '四平路校区', raw: `示例楼${index}` }))
+    await writeFile(input, JSON.stringify([...entries, entries[0]]))
+    expect(await prepareRequests(input, output, 122)).toEqual({ inputs: 21, batches: 2 })
+    const request = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(output, 'batch-0001.json'), 'utf8'))
+    expect(request.result_schema.required).toHaveLength(20)
+    expect(request.messages[0].content).toContain('time')
+    expect(request.messages.at(-1).role).toBe('user')
+    expect(JSON.parse(request.messages.at(-1).content).entries).toHaveLength(20)
+    const manifest = JSON.parse(await readFile(join(output, 'manifest.json'), 'utf8'))
+    const results = Object.fromEntries(manifest.entries.map((entry: { id: string; raw: string }) => [entry.id,
+      { ...result, locations: [{ ...member, source_text: entry.raw }] }]))
+    const assembled = assembleDictionary(manifest, results, table._meta)
+    expect(validateDictionary(assembled).inputs).toBe(21)
+    expect(assembled._meta.review_status).toBe('review_2_pending')
+    expect(() => assembleDictionary(manifest, {}, table._meta)).toThrow(/IDs/)
+    expect(() => assembleDictionary(manifest, { ...results, extra: result }, table._meta)).toThrow(/IDs/)
+    expect(() => assembleDictionary(manifest, results, { ...table._meta, calendar_id: 123 })).toThrow(/Calendar/)
+    await expect(prepareRequests(input, output, 122)).rejects.toThrow()
+    await writeFile(input, JSON.stringify([{ ...entries[0], studentId: 'must not be sent' }]))
+    await expect(prepareRequests(input, join(directory, 'invalid'), 122)).rejects.toThrow(/only/)
+  } finally { await rm(directory, { recursive: true, force: true }) }
+})

+import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
+import { after, before, test } from 'node:test'
+import { fileURLToPath } from 'node:url'
+import { chromium } from 'playwright'
+import { createServer } from 'vite'
+
+let server, browser, origin
+before(async () => {
+  server = await createServer({ root: fileURLToPath(new URL('../', import.meta.url)), server: { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0, open: false } })
+  await server.listen()
+  origin = `http://127.0.0.1:${server.httpServer.address().port}`
+  browser = await chromium.launch()
+})
+after(async () => { await browser?.close(); await server?.close() })
+
+const unavailable = {
+  zh: { github: 'GitHub 暂未开放', google: 'Google 暂未开放' },
+  en: { github: 'GitHub is not available yet', google: 'Google is not available yet' },
+  ja: { github: 'GitHub はまだ利用できません', google: 'Google はまだ利用できません' },
+  de: { github: 'GitHub ist noch nicht verfügbar', google: 'Google ist noch nicht verfügbar' },
+}
+
+for (const lang of Object.keys(unavailable)) for (const width of [320, 1280]) for (const theme of ['gf-light', 'gf-dark']) {
+  test(`unconfigured OAuth controls are disabled, localized and visible: ${lang}, ${width}px, ${theme}`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 950 } })
+    const errors = []
+    page.on('pageerror', error => errors.push(error.message))
+    try {
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/tongji-login.html?lang=${lang}&mode=login&github=off&google=off&theme=${theme}`)
+      await page.locator('html[data-ready="true"]').waitFor()
+
+      for (const provider of ['github', 'google']) {
+        const control = page.locator(`[data-oauth-provider="${provider}"]:visible`)
+        await control.waitFor()
+        assert.equal(await control.count(), 1)
+        assert.equal(await control.evaluate(element => element.tagName), 'BUTTON')
+        assert.equal(await control.isDisabled(), true)
+        assert.equal(await control.getAttribute('href'), null)
+        assert.equal((await control.textContent()).trim(), unavailable[lang][provider])
+
+        const accessible = await control.ariaSnapshot()
+        assert.ok(accessible.includes(unavailable[lang][provider]), accessible)
+        assert.match(accessible, /disabled/i)
+
+        const visual = await control.evaluate(element => {
+          const style = getComputedStyle(element)
+          const box = element.getBoundingClientRect()
+          element.focus()
+          return {
+            display: style.display,
+            opacity: style.opacity,
+            color: style.color,
+            width: box.width,
+            left: box.left,
+            right: box.right,
+            focused: document.activeElement === element,
+          }
+        })
+        assert.notEqual(visual.display, 'none')
+        assert.equal(visual.opacity, '0.7')
+        assert.notEqual(visual.color, 'rgba(0, 0, 0, 0)')
+        assert.ok(visual.width >= 40 && visual.left >= 0 && visual.right <= width + 1)
+        assert.equal(visual.focused, false, 'a disabled login control must not receive keyboard focus')
+      }
+
+      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.dataset.theme), theme)
+      assert.equal(await page.evaluate(() => document.documentElement.scrollWidth <= innerWidth), true)
+      assert.deepEqual(errors, [])
+    } finally { await page.close() }
+  })
+}
+
+for (const width of [320, 1280]) {
+  test(`configured GitHub entry remains keyboard-accessible at ${width}px`, async () => {
+    const page = await browser.newPage({ viewport: { width, height: 950 } })
+    try {
+      await page.goto(`${origin}/assets/test/fixtures/browser/tongji-login.html?lang=en&mode=login&google=off&theme=gf-light`)
+      await page.locator('html[data-ready="true"]').waitFor()
+      const link = page.locator('[data-oauth-provider="github"]:visible')
+      await link.waitFor()
+      assert.equal(await link.count(), 1)
+      assert.equal(await link.evaluate(element => element.tagName), 'A')
+      assert.equal(await link.getAttribute('href'), '/api/auth/github')
+      assert.match(await link.ariaSnapshot(), /link "GitHub"/i)
+
+      let reachableByTab = false
+      for (let attempt = 0; attempt < 24; attempt++) {
+        await page.keyboard.press('Tab')
+        if (await link.evaluate(element => document.activeElement === element)) {
+          reachableByTab = true
+          break
+        }
+      }
+      assert.equal(reachableByTab, true, 'the configured OAuth link must participate in keyboard navigation')
+    } finally { await page.close() }
+  })
+}

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'
+import { flushPromises, mount, type VueWrapper } from '@vue/test-utils'
+import * as api from '../src/runtime/api'
+import { i18n } from '../src/runtime/i18n'
+import ModerationActionPage from '../src/site/pages/ModerationActionPage.vue'
+import type { ModerationApprovalActionView } from '@gooseforum/client'
+
+const wrappers: VueWrapper[] = []
+afterEach(() => { wrappers.splice(0).forEach(w => w.unmount()); vi.restoreAllMocks(); window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/') })
+const view = (extra: Partial<ModerationApprovalActionView> = {}): ModerationApprovalActionView => ({
+  state: 'ready', subject: 'appeal', action: 'reject', targetType: 'topic', targetId: 7, title: 'Course notes',
+  excerpt: 'Rejected revision', originalReason: 'Looks like a duplicate', appealReason: 'Different angle, sources added',
+  workbenchUrl: '/moderation?tab=appeals', expiresAt: '2099-01-02T00:00:00Z', ...extra,
+})
+async function mountPage(preview: ModerationApprovalActionView) {
+  window.history.replaceState(null, '', '/moderation/action?token=v1.abc.def')
+  vi.spyOn(api, 'previewModerationApprovalAction').mockResolvedValue(preview)
+  const w = mount(ModerationActionPage, { props: { layout: {} as never, props: {} }, global: { plugins: [i18n] }, attachTo: document.body })
+  wrappers.push(w)
+  await flushPromises()
+  return w
+}
+
+test('appeal rejection shows both sides and requires a reason the author will see', async () => {
+  i18n.global.locale.value = 'en'
+  const execute = vi.spyOn(api, 'executeModerationApprovalAction').mockResolvedValue(view({ state: 'done' }))
+  const w = await mountPage(view())
+  expect(w.text()).toContain('Reject appeal')
+  expect(w.text()).toContain('Looks like a duplicate')
+  expect(w.text()).toContain('Different angle, sources added')
+  expect(w.get('label[for="moderation-action-reason"]').text()).toBe('Reason for rejecting')
+
+  const confirm = w.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === 'Reject appeal')!
+  await confirm.trigger('click'); await flushPromises()
+  expect(execute).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+  expect(w.get('#moderation-action-reason').attributes('aria-invalid')).toBe('true')
+  expect(w.get('#moderation-action-reason-help').text()).toContain('Add a reason before rejecting.')
+
+  await w.get('#moderation-action-reason').setValue('  Duplicates an existing topic  ')
+  await confirm.trigger('click'); await flushPromises()
+  expect(execute).toHaveBeenCalledWith('v1.abc.def', 'Duplicates an existing topic')
+  expect(w.get('[role="status"]').text()).toBe(i18n.global.t('moderationAction.states.done'))
+})
+
+test('appeal approval needs no reason; stale appeals and other subjects keep their own copy', async () => {
+  i18n.global.locale.value = 'en'
+  const execute = vi.spyOn(api, 'executeModerationApprovalAction').mockResolvedValue(view({ action: 'approve', state: 'done' }))
+  const approve = await mountPage(view({ action: 'approve' }))
+  expect(approve.get('label[for="moderation-action-reason"]').text()).toBe('Note to the author (optional)')
+  await approve.findAll('button').find(b => b.text() === 'Approve appeal and publish')!.trigger('click'); await flushPromises()
+  expect(execute).toHaveBeenCalledWith('v1.abc.def', '')
+
+  const stale = await mountPage(view({ state: 'changed' }))
+  expect(stale.get('[role="status"]').text()).toContain('This appeal needs no action.')
+  expect(stale.find('#moderation-action-reason').exists()).toBe(false)
+
+  const review = await mountPage({ state: 'ready', subject: 'review.topic', action: 'reject', targetType: 'topic', title: 'Pending', workbenchUrl: '/moderation?tab=review' })
+  expect(review.find('#moderation-action-reason').exists()).toBe(false)
+  expect(review.findAll('button').some(b => b.text() === i18n.global.t('moderationAction.actions.reject'))).toBe(true)
+})

+// @vitest-environment happy-dom
+import { afterEach, expect, test, vi } from 'vitest'

+const { fetchNotifications, markNotificationRead, markAllNotificationsRead } = vi.hoisted(() => ({
+  fetchNotifications: vi.fn(),
+  markNotificationRead: vi.fn(),

+  unreadSetNotifications: vi.fn(),
+  unreadRefresh: vi.fn(),
+  unreadClearNotifications: vi.fn(),
+}))
+vi.mock('../src/runtime/unread-status', () => ({
+  useUnreadStatus: () => ({ clearNotifications: unreadClearNotifications, setNotifications: unreadSetNotifications, refresh: unreadRefresh }),
+}))
+import NotificationsPage from '../src/site/pages/NotificationsPage.vue'
+import { markAllNotificationsRead, markNotificationRead } from '../src/runtime/api'
+afterEach(()=>vi.clearAllMocks())
+function item(eventType='post_reply'): NotificationPayload {
+ return {id:1,eventType,isRead:false,createdAt:'',title:'',content:'',actor:{id:1,username:'Alice'},topic:{id:42,title:'Campus',url:'/p/post/42/2'},payload:{actorId:1,topicTitle:'Campus'}}
+}
+test.each(['zh','en','ja','de'] as const)('complete public copy and direct mention priority in %s',async locale=>{
+ await setLocale(locale)
+ const n=item(); n.payload.hasDirectMention=true
+ const text=notificationText(n,i18n.global.t)
+ expect(text).toContain('Alice');expect(text).toContain('Campus');expect(text).not.toContain('notifications.')
+ expect(text).not.toBe(notificationText(item(),i18n.global.t))
+ expect(notificationText({...item('old'),title:'notifications.templates.unknown'},i18n.global.t)).toBe(i18n.global.t('notifications.fallback'))
+ expect(notificationText({...item('old'),title:'Public account notice'},i18n.global.t)).toBe('Public account notice')
+})
+test('category and unread filter combine in server queries, including empty categories',async()=>{
+ await setLocale('en')
+ fetchNotifications.mockResolvedValue({items:[],nextCursor:0,hasNext:false,unreadCount:1})
+ const wrapper=mount(NotificationsPage,{props:{layout:{} as any,props:{notifications:[item()],total:1,unreadCount:1,pagination:{page:1,nextPage:0,hasNext:false,nextUrl:''}}},global:{plugins:[i18n]}})
+ await wrapper.findAll('button').find(button=>button.text()==='Mentions')!.trigger('click')
+ await flushPromises()
+ expect(fetchNotifications).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('all',0,20,'mentions')

+// 同一次 flush 内既发生服务端 props 刷新、又发生用户点击时，点击必须生效：

+test('a props refresh in the same flush as a category click still loads the clicked category',async()=>{
+ await setLocale('en')
+ fetchNotifications.mockResolvedValue({items:[],nextCursor:0,hasNext:false,unreadCount:1})
+ const wrapper=mount(NotificationsPage,{props:{layout:{} as any,props:{category:'all',filter:'all',notifications:[item()],total:1,unreadCount:1,pagination:{page:1,nextPage:0,hasNext:false,nextUrl:''}}},global:{plugins:[i18n]}})
+ fetchNotifications.mockClear()
+ // 不 await：props 更新与随后的点击落在同一 flush。
+ void wrapper.setProps({props:{category:'all',filter:'all',notifications:[item()],total:1,unreadCount:1,pagination:{page:1,nextPage:0,hasNext:false,nextUrl:''}}})
+ await wrapper.findAll('button').find(button=>button.text()==='Likes')!.trigger('click')
+ await flushPromises()
+ expect(fetchNotifications).toHaveBeenLastCalledWith('all',0,20,'likes')
+ expect(wrapper.findAll('button').find(button=>button.text()==='Likes')!.attributes('aria-pressed')).toBe('true')
+ wrapper.unmount()
+})
+
+test('server-rendered category refresh restores both filters without re-fetching supplied rows', async()=>{
+ await setLocale('en')
+ const wrapper=mount(NotificationsPage,{props:{layout:{} as any,props:{category:'mentions',filter:'unread',notifications:[item()],total:1,unreadCount:1,pagination:{page:1,nextPage:0,hasNext:false,nextUrl:''}}},global:{plugins:[i18n]}})

+ await wrapper.setProps({props:{category:'system',filter:'all',notifications:[item('system')],total:1,unreadCount:1,pagination:{page:1,nextPage:0,hasNext:false,nextUrl:''}}})
+ await flushPromises()
+ expect(wrapper.findAll('button').find(button=>button.text()==='System')!.attributes('aria-pressed')).toBe('true')
+ expect(wrapper.get('input[type="checkbox"]').element).toHaveProperty('checked',false)
+ expect(fetchNotifications).not.toHaveBeenCalled()
+ wrapper.unmount()
+})
+
+test.each(['zh','en','ja','de'] as const)('all event copy has resolved placeholders in %s', async locale => {
+ await setLocale(locale)
+ for (const type of ['mention','post_reply','comment','like','follow','topic_post','wiki_updated','badge','system','review_pending','review_approved','review_rejected']) {
+  const n=item(type); n.payload.metadata={badgeName:'Welcome'}

+ await setLocale('en')
+ let finish!: () => void
+ vi.mocked(markAllNotificationsRead).mockReturnValueOnce(new Promise<void>(resolve => { finish = resolve }))
+ fetchNotifications.mockResolvedValue({items:[item('system')],nextCursor:0,hasNext:false,unreadCount:1})
+ const wrapper=mount(NotificationsPage,{props:{layout:{} as any,props:{notifications:[item()],total:1,unreadCount:1,pagination:{page:1,nextPage:0,hasNext:false,nextUrl:''}}},global:{plugins:[i18n]}})
+ await wrapper.findAll('button').find(button=>button.text()===i18n.global.t('notifications.markAllRead'))!.trigger('click')

+ wrapper.unmount()
+})

+test('stale single-item mark-read failure never rolls back a newer category unread count', async () => {
+ await setLocale('en')
+ let rejectMark!: (reason: unknown) => void
+ const staleMark = new Promise<boolean>((_, reject) => { rejectMark = reject })
+ vi.mocked(markNotificationRead).mockReturnValueOnce(staleMark)
+ unreadRefresh.mockResolvedValue(undefined)
+ const wrapper = mount(NotificationsPage, { props: { layout: {} as any, props: { notifications: [item()], total: 1, unreadCount: 3, pagination: { page: 1, nextPage: 0, hasNext: false, nextUrl: '' } } }, global: { plugins: [i18n] } })
+ expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('3 unread')
+ await wrapper.findAll('article').find(article => article.text().includes('Campus'))!.find('a').trigger('click')
+ // Switch to Mentions, which loads a fresh category with a smaller unread count.
+ fetchNotifications.mockResolvedValueOnce({ items: [item('mention')], nextCursor: 0, hasNext: false, unreadCount: 1 })
+ await wrapper.findAll('button').find(button => button.text() === 'Mentions')!.trigger('click')

+ // Now the category A request fails; the stale rollback must not resurrect A's count.

+ await flushPromises()
+ expect(wrapper.text()).toContain('1 unread')
+ expect(wrapper.text()).not.toContain('3 unread')
+ expect(unreadRefresh).toHaveBeenCalledWith(true)
+ wrapper.unmount()
+})
